items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出一种残差学习框架，把网络层显式地重新表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非无参照的函数，从而让比以往深得多的网络更容易训练。经验证据表明，残差网络更容易优化，并且能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 上，我们评估了深度达 152 层的残差网络：它比 VGG 深 8 倍，但复杂度更低；其集成模型在测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。仅因用了极深的表示，COCO 目标检测就获得 28% 的相对提升。
items.highlight_zh: 残差学习让152层网络更易优化，夺得ILSVRC 2015分类第一
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：理论上网络越深表达力越强，但实践中层数一多就难训练，训练误差反而上升——这不是过拟合，而是“退化”问题，深层网络难以学出恒等映射。
2）方法：提出残差学习。传统做法让若干层直接拟合目标映射 H(x)；残差网络改为让这些层拟合残差 F(x)=H(x)−x，再通过“捷径连接”把输入加回去，得到 F(x)+x。如果最优映射接近恒等，网络只要把残差压到接近零即可，远比从零学一个恒等映射容易。捷径连接不增加参数、不增加计算量。作者还讨论了瓶颈（bottleneck）结构与更深的瓶颈残差块。
3）结果：在 ImageNet 上，152 层残差网络比 VGG 深 8 倍而计算量更低；集成模型在测试集上错误率 3.57%，拿下 ILSVRC 2015 分类第一。基于同一骨干，团队还在 ImageNet 检测、ImageNet 定位、COCO 检测与 COCO 分割四项任务中夺冠。在 CIFAR-10 上验证了 100 层乃至 1000 层网络仍可训练。
4）为何重要：它证明了“表示深度”本身对视觉识别任务至关重要，而非单纯堆参数；残差连接简单、通用，此后几乎成为所有深层网络的标准构件，其思想也延续到 Transformer 等架构中。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 使用 AlphaFold 进行高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。经大量实验努力，约10万个独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只占已知数十亿条蛋白质序列的极小部分：测定单个结构需数月到数年，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质三维结构，是50多年来悬而未决的重要开放问题；现有方法尤其在无同源结构可用时远达不到原子精度。我们提出首个能在无相似结构时也常以原子精度预测结构的计算方法，并在CASP14上验证了全新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold：多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，显著优于其他方法。其关键在于把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（借助多序列比对）融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: AlphaFold 在 CASP14 上达到接近实验结构的原子级精度
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：已知的蛋白质序列有数十亿条，而实验解析出的结构只有约10万个；测定一个结构往往要花数月到数年，形成巨大的“结构覆盖缺口”。仅由氨基酸序列推断三维结构的“蛋白质折叠问题”已悬置50多年，此前方法在找不到同源模板时精度远不够用。
2）方法：AlphaFold 是完全重新设计的深度学习模型，输入是氨基酸序列与多序列比对（MSA），网络同时维护“序列—残基对”两种表示并相互交换信息，直接输出每个原子的三维坐标及置信度。它并未只做纯数据驱动：把关于蛋白质结构的物理与几何知识（例如分子骨架的刚性、侧链的扭转角约束）嵌入网络结构设计，并以端到端方式训练。
3）结果：在第14届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）盲测中，AlphaFold 在多数目标上的精度可与实验测得的结构相竞争，并大幅领先其他参赛方法；在没有相似结构可参考的困难目标上优势尤其明显。作者据此提出，这是首个在缺少同源结构时仍能常规给出原子级精度的计算方法。
4）为何重要：它把结构生物学从“一个个做实验”推向可规模化计算的结构生物信息学，对基础生物学、药物发现与酶设计都有深远影响。同时也说明：把领域知识（多序列比对、几何约束）写进网络结构，是深度学习在科学问题上奏效的关键。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 基于衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学的衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：经过深度学习设计的一组被动衍射层可以协同工作，学会实现多种功能。我们在太赫兹波段制作了3D打印的 D2NN，并实验演示了手写数字分类与成像透镜功能，验证了这一框架的可行性。借助现有的众多3D打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，该全光学深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光学图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中获得应用，还可催生能够利用 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用3D打印被动衍射层，以光速完成全光学分类与成像
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：深度学习通常运行在电子计算机上，算力与能耗随网络规模迅速增长。能否让光本身直接“做”神经网络的计算，从而以光速、低功耗完成特定任务？
2）方法：把神经网络的每一“层”设计成一片被动的衍射元件（对光波做相位/振幅调制）。光穿过叠放的若干片层时，逐层被调制；层与层之间的自由空间传播相当于光的衍射，天然实现了“全连接”式的信息混合。作者把每层的相位分布当作可训练参数，用深度学习中的反向传播离线设计这些层，再用3D打印在太赫兹波段加工出实物器件。计算由光在器件中的传播完成，无需电子电路参与。
3）结果：实验制作了3D打印的 D2NN，并成功演示了两项功能——对手写数字图像进行分类，以及实现一个成像透镜的作用。也就是说，同一套设计框架既能做模式识别，也能做光学元件设计。
4）为何重要：它表明神经网络的“推理”可以由被动光学结构承担，速度取决于光的传播而非时钟频率，功耗低，且可用空间光调制器实现可编程版本。潜在应用包括全光学图像分析、特征检测、目标分类，以及能“学会”完成特殊任务的新型相机与光学元件。需要注意的是，这类器件多为被动线性元件，通常针对单一任务设计，可重构性与非线性表达仍是后续要解决的问题。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且被广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得当前最佳结果。我们提出一种面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们总结了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的设计洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些设计，XGBoost 以远少于现有系统的资源扩展到十亿级样本规模。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知算法与加权分位数草图让树提升扩展到十亿级样本
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：梯度提升树（GBDT 一类方法）精度高、使用广，但当数据规模庞大、特征高度稀疏时，训练的速度与内存会成为瓶颈；业界需要一个从数据读取到模型训练都能“端到端”扩展的系统。
2）方法：算法层面，作者给出带正则项的目标函数（惩罚树的叶子数与叶子权重），用二阶梯度近似来求解分裂增益；提出“稀疏感知”的分裂查找算法，为每个特征给出一个默认分支方向，从而自动处理缺失值与稀疏输入；提出加权分位数草图，用流式/分布式方式快速选出近似学习的候选分裂点。系统层面，总结了按列分块存储、缓存感知的预取访问、块压缩与分片等工程手段，并支持多线程并行与分布式训练。
3）结果：把这些设计组合起来，XGBoost 能用远少于已有系统的资源扩展到十亿级样本；作者报告其在多个机器学习挑战与基准上取得当时的最佳效果。
4）为何重要：它把“统计/优化上的改进”与“底层系统工程的优化”结合起来，证明了二者协同设计的价值，也因此成为应用机器学习中最常用的工具之一，并推动了后续 LightGBM、CatBoost 等树提升系统的发展。对非本领域读者可以这样理解：它让“很多棵小决策树逐步纠错”这种简单而强大的方法，真正跑得动工业级的海量数据。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 通过在所有层中同时结合左右上下文，从无标注文本中预训练深层双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需新增一个输出层做微调，即可在问答、语言推断等大量任务上得到当前最优模型，而无需对任务特定架构做大幅改动。BERT 概念简单但实证有力，在 11 项自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 得分提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率达 86.7%（提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 达 93.2（提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达 83.1（提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加微调的范式横扫 11 项 NLP 任务
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：此前的语言表示模型（如 ELMo、GPT）要么单向看文本，要么把两个单向模型简单拼接，无法真正同时利用上下文。BERT 想回答：能否预训练一个真正的深度双向表示，再迁移到各种下游任务？
方法：只用无标注文本做两件事——随机遮住部分词，让模型根据左右文猜出被遮词（掩码语言模型）；再判断两句话是否相邻。因为 Transformer 编码器同时看到所有位置，“双向”是天然实现的。下游使用时只需加一层输出并微调，不必为每个任务重新设计网络结构。
结果：在 11 项 NLP 任务上刷新纪录，GLUE 提升 7.7 个百分点至 80.5%，问答与自然语言推断任务也显著进步。
为何重要：它把“大规模预训练 + 轻量微调”确立为 NLP 的标准范式，让研究者不必为每个任务从零训练模型，极大降低了应用门槛，也直接启发了此后一大批预训练语言模型，是当代大模型时代的重要起点。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个可用单目、双目与 RGB-D 相机（支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型）完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个创新是基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，使系统能在室内外大、小场景中实时稳健运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个创新是多地图系统，它依赖召回率更高的新场景识别方法：当长期缺乏有效视觉信息而跟丢时，系统可新建地图，并在重访已建图区域时与旧地图无缝合并。与只利用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 是首个在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息的系统，可将共视关键帧纳入光束法平差，即使它们时间相隔很远或来自先前建图会话。实验显示各传感器配置下它都与现有最佳系统同样稳健且显著更精确：双目-惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均精度 3.6 厘米，在 TUM-VI 房间快速手持运动场景下达 9 毫米。源码已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉、视觉惯性与多地图的开源 SLAM 库
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人要在未知环境里靠相机（单目、双目或 RGB-D）和惯性测量单元（IMU）同时定位与建图，但以往系统往往只适配某一种传感器组合，而且当画面长时间没有有效信息时会彻底跟丢，无法恢复。
方法：ORB-SLAM3 用 ORB 特征搭建统一框架，把视觉与惯性信息紧耦合，整个估计过程——包括 IMU 初始化——都建立在最大后验估计之上；同时引入召回率更高的场景识别。跟丢时系统新建一张地图，重访旧区域再把多张地图无缝合并，并允许时间上相隔很远、甚至来自旧会话的关键帧一起参与光束法平差，从而获得大视差观测。
结果：所有传感器配置下鲁棒性与文献中最好的系统相当、精度显著更高（比以往方法准 2–5 倍）；双目-惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均精度 3.6 厘米，TUM-VI 快速手持场景下约 9 毫米。
为何重要：它第一次让系统在所有算法阶段都复用历史信息，并支持多地图，对 AR/VR、无人机与移动机器人很有实用价值；作者已开源代码，推动了整个 SLAM 社区的可复现研究。

items.title_en: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.title_zh: Reframe：面向智能体视觉推理的观测对齐多教师同策略蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习与多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）为后训练提供了互补路径，但对视觉智能体而言，工具使用带来两个相互关联的难题：模型可能忽视工具返回的有用观测，而缺乏依据的动作又会限制后续蒸馏可用的证据。我们提出 Reframe，一个把观测状态（而非仅有输出分布）作为对齐对象的后训练框架。首先，Ground-Drop-GRPO（GD-GRPO）以证据感知奖励并随机移除原始视觉输入，训练空间与时间专家，促使它们获取有依据的证据并利用返回观测。其次，Observation-Gated-MOPD（OG-MOPD）在 rollout 过程中用规范动作替换有缺陷的工具动作，并从修复后的观测继续蒸馏。两阶段互补：学会依赖工具返回观测，也能让策略从观测修复中获益。两阶段均无需任务专属的 SFT 冷启动。在 14 个图像与视频基准上的大量实验表明，Reframe 优于 Mix-RL 与普通 MOPD；消融显示 GD-GRPO 相比基于结果的 GRPO 提升了观测依赖与工具收益。
items.highlight_zh: 以观测状态为对齐对象，修复工具动作再蒸馏
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：视觉智能体可以使用工具（比如裁剪、放大图片）辅助推理，但常犯两个毛病：一是“看不见”工具返回的新观测，仍只盯着原始图像；二是动作本身不靠谱，导致后续拿到的证据质量差，蒸馏也难以学到有用东西。
方法：Reframe 把“观测状态”而不只是输出分布当作对齐对象，分两步。第一步 GD-GRPO：用证据感知的奖励训练空间与时间两个专家模型，并随机丢掉原始视觉输入，逼模型必须依赖工具返回的观测。第二步 OG-MOPD：在 rollout 中把有缺陷的工具动作替换成规范动作，从“修好的观测”继续做同策略蒸馏。两步互补——学会依赖观测，才能从观测修复中真正受益——而且都不需要任务专属的 SFT 冷启动。
结果：在 14 个图像与视频基准上优于 Mix-RL 和普通 MOPD；消融实验显示 GD-GRPO 相比基于结果的 GRPO 提高了模型对观测的依赖程度和工具使用带来的收益。
为何重要：它为智能体视觉推理的后训练提供了一个无需冷启动、可组合的方案，指出“对齐观测”与“修复动作”应当协同设计，而不仅是对齐最终答案的分布。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Applications of Fairness Training in Artificial Intelligence to Ophthalmic Disease Diagnosis using External Eye Photographs
items.title_zh: 公平性训练在外眼照片眼科疾病诊断人工智能中的应用
items.abstract_en: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), age-related macular degeneration (AMD), and glaucoma are leading causes of preventable blindness, yet whether external eye photographs carry phenotypic information about posterior segment disease remains unclear, and methods to mitigate demographic disparities in such models are largely unexplored. We developed and evaluated deep learning and vision-language models for binary classification of vision-threatening DR (VTDR), advanced AMD, and glaucoma using 40,687 external eye photographs from 9,878 patients at Massachusetts Eye and Ear. Convolutional networks (WResNet, EfficientNet), a vision transformer (ViT), and a fine-tuned vision-language model (LLaVA) were assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with fairness across sex, race, and ethnicity quantified by the equity-scaled AUC (ES-AUC). Five fairness-training strategies were applied to the best models. LLaVA achieved the highest baseline AUC for VTDR (85.4%, comparable to ViT 82.6%); advanced AMD was similar across architectures (EfficientNet 86.3%; LLaVA 84.8%; ViT 84.7%), whereas glaucoma was substantially worse (67-74%). Fairness training improved VTDR and AMD AUCs to 86.3% and 85.9% while partially mitigating demographic disparities. In summary, although AI models that rely on external eye photography to detect posterior segment disease may not yet be suitable for clinical deployment, the fairness methods demonstrated in this proof-of-concept study could be applied to other AI systems to decrease performance disparities and potentially improve model performance.
items.abstract_zh: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）、年龄相关黄斑变性和青光眼是可预防失明的主要原因，但外眼照片是否携带后节疾病的表型信息仍不清楚，缓解此类模型人群差异的方法也少有探索。我们使用马萨诸塞眼耳医院 9,878 名患者的 40,687 张外眼照片，开发并评估了用于威胁视力 DR（VTDR）、晚期 AMD 和青光眼二分类的深度学习与视觉语言模型。卷积网络（WResNet、EfficientNet）、视觉 Transformer（ViT）和微调的视觉语言模型（LLaVA）以 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）评估，性别、种族与族裔间的公平性用公平性标度 AUC（ES-AUC）量化，并对最佳模型施加五种公平性训练策略。LLaVA 在 VTDR 上基线 AUC 最高（85.4%，ViT 82.6%）；晚期 AMD 各架构相近（EfficientNet 86.3%、LLaVA 84.8%、ViT 84.7%），青光眼明显更差（67–74%）。公平性训练将 VTDR 与 AMD 的 AUC 提升至 86.3% 和 85.9%，并部分缓解了人群差异。总之，仅靠外眼照片检测后节疾病的 AI 模型或许尚不适合临床部署，但本概念验证中展示的公平性方法可迁移到其他 AI 系统，以减少性能差距并可能提升模型表现。
items.highlight_zh: 公平性训练可缩小眼科 AI 的人群性能差距
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：糖尿病视网膜病变、年龄相关黄斑变性和青光眼是主要的可预防致盲原因。检查这些“眼底”疾病通常需要专门设备，而用便宜易得的外眼照片能否看出端倪尚不清楚；同时，这类模型在不同性别、种族之间会不会“偏心”，以及能否用公平性训练来纠正，也几乎没有研究。
方法：研究纳入马萨诸塞眼耳医院 9,878 名患者的 40,687 张外眼照片，训练卷积网络（WResNet、EfficientNet）、视觉 Transformer（ViT）和微调的视觉语言模型（LLaVA），对三种疾病做二分类；用 AUC 衡量判别能力，用公平性标度 AUC（ES-AUC）衡量性别、种族、族裔间的差距；随后对表现最好的模型施加五种公平性训练策略。
结果：LLaVA 在威胁视力 DR 上基线 AUC 最高（85.4%），晚期 AMD 各架构相近（约 85%–86%），青光眼则明显更弱（67%–74%）。公平性训练把 VTDR 和 AMD 的 AUC 提到 86.3% 和 85.9%，并部分缩小了人群差距。
为何重要：这说明仅凭外眼照片筛查后节疾病目前还达不到临床可用水平，但论文验证的公平性训练流程是通用的，可移植到其他医疗 AI，用于减小性能差距、甚至顺便提升整体精度，为“更公平也更好用”的模型提供了概念验证。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Demonstration of a partial knowledge quantum key distribution protocol
items.title_zh: Bridge[2,3] 部分知识量子密钥分发协议的实验演示
items.abstract_en: We demonstrate a novel QKD protocol, named \texttt{Bridge[$d,q$]}, which generalizes the \texttt{SARG04} protocol to $d$ dimensions and $q$ bases. In this protocol, Alice and Bob gain only partial knowledge about each other's raw key. Nevertheless, this partial information is sufficient to distill a definite mutual encryption key. We present an experimental demonstration of the \texttt{Bridge[$2,3$]} protocol. The three unbiased polarization bases were switched using a single Pockels cell. The applied polarization basis switching method is relevant to any 3-basis QKD protocol and to other applications that require fast manipulation of photon polarization qubits.
items.abstract_zh: 本文演示了一种新的量子密钥分发（QKD）协议 Bridge[d,q]，它把 SARG04 协议推广到 d 个维度和 q 个基。在该协议中，Alice 与 Bob 对彼此的原始密钥只掌握部分知识，但这些部分信息已足以提炼出一个确定的共享加密密钥。我们给出了 Bridge[2,3] 协议的实验演示，使用单个 Pockels 单元完成三个无偏偏振基的切换。所采用的偏振基切换方法可推广到任意三基 QKD 协议，以及其他需要快速操控光子偏振量子比特的应用。
items.highlight_zh: 三基QKD实验演示：仅凭部分密钥信息即可提取共享密钥
items.digest_zh:
研究了什么问题：量子密钥分发（QKD）要让通信双方安全协商出相同的密钥。传统协议（如 BB84、SARG04）中，接收方需要确切知道自己测到的是哪个比特；本文提出的 Bridge[d,q] 反其道而行，让 Alice 和 Bob 对彼此的原始密钥只掌握“部分知识”，但这点部分信息经后处理足以提炼出确定的共享密钥，并把 SARG04 从二维情形推广到 d 维、q 个基的一般框架。
用了什么方法：作者选取最简单的实例 Bridge[2,3]（二维量子比特、三个基）做实验验证。三个基彼此“无偏”（相互共轭），实验中用一个 Pockels 电光调制器即可在三个偏振基之间快速切换，避免多器件切换带来的复杂度与损耗。
有什么结果：论文完成了该协议的实验演示，证明“部分知识”这条路线在真实光学装置上可行；同时指出，单个 Pockels 单元实现三基切换这一方案本身具有通用价值，可直接用于任何三基 QKD 协议。
为何重要：其一，它把 QKD 协议族从固定维度或基数的“点”扩展成可按需调节的“面”，在安全性与实现难度之间提供新的折中空间；其二，快速、简洁的偏振基切换是高速偏振编码 QKD 的关键工程环节，本文方法也可迁移到其他需要快速操控光子偏振量子比特的场景。需注意，摘要仅报告演示与定性结论，密钥率、误码率等具体指标需参见原文。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment
items.title_zh: 面向 ICU 出院风险评估的运作感知多模态临床决策支持系统
items.abstract_en: Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. In 20 independent runs across 20,000 ICU stays from MIMIC-III, empirical findings demonstrate that: vital signs alone have limited predictive capacity under real-world class imbalance (PR-AUC of 0.1387 +/- 0.0086); directly concatenating raw text embeddings degrades decision tree performance (XGBoost and LightGBM PR-AUC drop to 0.3893 and 0.4030); whereas an end-to-end multimodal fine-tuning architecture (Transformer E2E FineTune) utilizing layer-wise parameter freezing and differential learning rates reverses text negative transfer, achieving the highest AUROC of 0.8288 +/- 0.0110, PR-AUC of 0.4373 +/- 0.0310, and F1-Score of 0.4757 +/- 0.0196. Operational indicators supply independent risk signals, laying an engineering foundation for high-utility clinical decision support tools.
items.abstract_zh: 非计划性 30 天 ICU 再入院是衡量医疗质量的重要指标，但多数预测模型只关注患者个体病理生理状态，忽略了医院运营环境与床位周转压力。本文提出运作感知的多模态临床决策支持系统（CDSS）：用多智能体协同抽取结合自演化检索增强生成（RAG）清除病程记录的模板噪声，并融合科室工作负荷指标、入院流量特征、连续生命体征与稀疏的 ICD/DRG 编码；针对约 10.5% 再入院的严重不平衡与报警疲劳，采用类别重加权和决策阈值校准。在 MIMIC-III 的 2 万次 ICU 住院上做 20 次独立实验：仅用生命体征预测力有限（PR-AUC≈0.139），直接拼接原始文本嵌入反而拖累 XGBoost 与 LightGBM（PR-AUC 0.389/0.403）；而采用逐层参数冻结与差异化学习率的端到端多模态微调 Transformer 扭转了文本负迁移，取得最高 AUROC 0.8288、PR-AUC 0.4373、F1 0.4757。
items.highlight_zh: 融合运营指标与多模态微调，ICU再入院预测AUROC达0.83
items.digest_zh:
研究了什么问题：ICU 常把“30 天内非计划再入院”作为医疗质量考核指标，许多机器学习模型据此预测哪位病人出院后风险高。但这些模型几乎只看病人自身生理指标，忽略了医院现实——出院往往是“病人是否稳定”与“床位是否紧张”之间的动态权衡；同时病程记录充满模板化套话，直接喂给模型反而引入噪声。在再入院样本仅约 10.5% 的严重不平衡下，模型还容易出现“报警疲劳”。
用了什么方法：作者搭建“运作感知”的多模态临床决策支持系统。文本侧用多智能体协同抽取加自演化的检索增强生成（RAG）清洗病程记录中的模板噪声；结构化侧除连续生命体征和稀疏的 ICD/DRG 编码外，还构造了科室工作负荷与入院流量特征。训练上做数据规范化、类别重加权与决策阈值校准来应对不平衡。
有什么结果：在 MIMIC-III 的 2 万次 ICU 住院数据上做 20 次独立运行：单靠生命体征预测力有限（PR-AUC≈0.139）；把原始文本嵌入直接拼进表格特征会拖累树模型（XGBoost、LightGBM 的 PR-AUC 降至 0.389/0.403，即“文本负迁移”）；而端到端多模态微调的 Transformer（逐层参数冻结＋差异化学习率）逆转了负迁移，AUROC 0.829、PR-AUC 0.437、F1 0.476，为最佳。
为何重要：说明运营层面的信息是独立于病人的风险信号，临床预测不能只盯病床旁的监护仪；也提示多模态融合并非“拼起来就好”，融合方式决定成败。这为真正可落地的出院决策支持打下工程基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
items.title_zh: LambdaMix：联合训练低秩适配器的可调控多目标群组相对偏好优化
items.abstract_en: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型部署时，用户偏好变化常要求在不同目标间做不同权衡，而标准后训练方法通常只针对固定目标权重产出单一策略。我们提出 LambdaMix——一种参数高效方法，用群组相对在线强化学习学习一个以偏好为条件的策略族。LambdaMix 在冻结的基座模型上为每个目标联合训练一个低秩适配器；一个偏好向量既决定生成回应时使用哪个适配器混合，又为各目标单独归一化后的奖励加权以更新适配器。单次训练即可支持推理时改变偏好而无需再优化。我们在四个模型上针对有用性与无害性、以及“解数学题同时遵循指令”两类任务做实验，并在两个最大模型上评估“改写评论：保留措辞同时减少个人属性线索”。在前两类任务上，LambdaMix 的超体积在所有四个模型上均优于所比较的条件化与策略合并基线，且所用训练补全与存储的适配器参数均少于一组 GRPO 专家策略。
items.highlight_zh: 一次训练即可在推理时调偏好，超体积全面超越基线
items.digest_zh:
研究了什么问题：大模型上线后，用户对“有用”“无害”“守指令”等目标的偏好会变，而常规后训练（如 RLHF/GRPO）只针对一组固定权重训出一个策略，偏好一变就得重训。理想情况是“训练一次，推理时随意调档”。
用了什么方法：作者提出 LambdaMix。它在冻结的基座模型上为每个目标各训练一个低秩适配器（LoRA）并联合优化；推理时给定一个偏好向量，该向量一方面决定按什么比例混合哪些适配器来生成回答，另一方面在训练中对各目标单独归一化后的奖励加权，去更新对应适配器。方法建立在群组相对（group-relative）的在线强化学习框架上，保留了 GRPO 一类方法无需 critic 的简洁性。
有什么结果：在四个模型上做两类任务——有用性与无害性的权衡，以及“解数学题同时遵循格式指令”的多目标任务——LambdaMix 的超体积（衡量多目标综合覆盖的指标）在所有模型上均高于所比较的条件化策略与策略合并基线；作者还在两个更大模型上验证了“改写评论：保留原措辞同时减少个人属性线索”这一任务。此外，它比训练一组 GRPO 专家策略消耗更少的训练补全、存储更少的适配器参数。固定架构与初始化后，同时改变适配器混合与目标权重，比只变其一能得到更宽的得分范围与更好的覆盖。
为何重要：给出了参数高效、可事后调控的多目标对齐方案，把“偏好”从训练期超参变成推理期可调旋钮，对需要频繁调整策略的产品部署很实用。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: 面向通用灵巧操作的异构触觉表征学习
items.abstract_en: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
items.abstract_zh: 触觉是接触丰富型灵巧操作不可或缺的模态，也是具身智能的前沿方向，但商用触觉传感器仍处于较早期阶段，各类传感器各有不可替代的优势与局限。关键挑战在于让触觉理解摆脱特定传感器的物理特性，从而有效利用异构触觉数据。为此我们提出 LingBot-Touch 触觉基础模型：（i）在压阻、磁性与视触觉等不同传感器上给出统一表征，并可较容易地扩展到新传感器类型；（ii）所得触觉 token 即插即用，可无缝接入从扩散策略到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（如 π0.5、LingBot-VLA）等不同范式的策略模型，稳定提升操作灵巧性；（iii）跨仿真与多硬件平台的真机实验表明，该表征显著有益于复杂操作任务，同时保持较强的计算效率。
items.highlight_zh: 跨传感器统一触觉表征，即插即用提升灵巧操作
items.digest_zh:
研究了什么问题：要让机器人手完成插拔、拧转、握持这类“接触丰富”的灵巧操作，触觉几乎不可替代。但现实中商用触觉传感器五花八门——压阻式、磁性、视触觉——各有优劣，数据格式与物理含义都不同，模型难以把不同来源的触觉数据合起来用，触觉学习因此难以规模化。
用了什么方法：作者提出触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch，核心目标是让触觉理解“脱离具体传感器的物理特性”，学到统一表征：不同传感器的输入被映射为同一种触觉 token，且新传感器类型可以较容易地接入。这些 token 被设计成“即插即用”，可直接接入不同范式的策略模型——从扩散策略（diffusion policy）到视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA，如 π0.5、LingBot-VLA）。
有什么结果：作者在仿真和多种硬件平台的真机上做了大量实验，结果显示该触觉表征能显著提升复杂操作任务的表现，同时保持较好的计算效率；接入不同策略范式时都能稳定带来灵巧性增益。
为何重要：它把“换一种传感器就要重训一套模型”变成“用统一 token 复用跨传感器数据”，为触觉数据的规模化利用提供了路径；论文还据此给出了对未来触觉硬件与具身模型设计的启示，对整个具身智能社区都有参考价值。需注意，摘要报告的是整体趋势性结论，具体任务与提升幅度需参见原文。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.title_zh: LIMBER：用于预测与理解 RNA 结构与功能的混合 RNA 基础模型
items.abstract_en: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript
items.abstract_zh: 训练好的动作策略把操作技能写进网络权重，使所学与训练分布绑定；上下文学习（ICL）虽无此耦合，却难以匹敌训练策略，因为异场景示范不含当前世界的反馈。我们发现智能体在上下文中习得的其实是语义（任务步骤与物体角色）而非视觉外观，经验因此可跨世界迁移。据此提出 World In-Context Learning（WICL）：冻结的模型从一条示范出发，在模拟器等世界中预演任务，把反馈写入上下文而非权重。所构建的 RoboScript 把学习结果固化为 Task Memory 并在新场景部署；在 RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个任务上，单条示范、无梯度更新即达 83.4% 平均成功率，超过最强训练型策略 20 多个百分点。
items.highlight_zh: 把世界反馈写进上下文而非权重，单条示范超越训练策略20点
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：机器人操作技能通常靠大规模数据训练“烧”进模型权重，换场景或换物体分布就退化；而只模仿一次的上下文学习又往往不如训练策略，因为别的场景录下的示范没有携带机器人当下所处世界的反馈。
2）关键观察：模型在上下文里记住的是“任务有哪些步骤、物体扮演什么角色”这类语义信息，而不是像素外观，所以在一个世界获得的经验能迁移到另一个世界。
3）方法：提出 WICL 范式并实现为 RoboScript。冻结的模型看完一条示范后先到仿真世界里“排练”任务，把成功与失败的反馈整理成记忆写入上下文（Task Memory），不改动任何权重；随后带着这份冻结记忆到新场景执行，并通过数据隔离保证部署时每个输入真实机器人都能获得。
4）结果：在 RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个任务上，每任务仅一条示范、无梯度更新，干净与随机化设置下平均成功率 83.4%，比最强训练型动作策略高 20 分以上；还能跨视觉分布泛化、通过反思自我改进、随基础模型变强而提升，并借助跨本体记忆适配迁移到真实双臂机器人。
5）为何重要：它给出“世界在环”的第三条路线——知识不写进权重而写进上下文，免去重训练、可解释、可迭代。需注意结论主要来自仿真基准，真机验证规模有限。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: LIMBER: A Hybrid RNA Foundation Model for Predicting and Understanding RNA Structure and Function
items.title_zh: 纯相位全息光镊阵列的强度极限
items.abstract_en: RNA foundation models offer a promising route to decoding the relationships between RNA sequence, structure and function, yet how model architecture shapes the acquisition and organization of biological information remains poorly understood. Here we introduce Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA (LIMBER), a hybrid foundation model integrating bidirectional self-attention with selective state-space modeling, pre-trained on 40.5 million non-coding RNA sequences. With task-specific fine-tuning, LIMBER achieves leading performance on secondary-structure prediction and non-coding RNA classification benchmarks, while demonstrating strong transferability to translation-related tasks and RNA--small-molecule interaction prediction. Beyond model development, we establish a unified, task-agnostic framework to systematically evaluate and interpret the biological knowledge intrinsically acquired by RNA foundation models. This framework validates LIMBER's strong capabilities in recovering RNA structures and predicting mutational effects, while uncovering a hierarchical, task-dependent organization of biological information across model layers. In addition, we demonstrate distinct scaling behaviors across structural, evolutionary, and functional capabilities by training and evaluating a broad panel of model variants spanning model capacity, training duration, and dataset size. Taken together, these findings establish LIMBER as a versatile RNA foundation model and provide insight into how architectural design, internal representations and scaling shape the learning of RNA sequence-structure-function relationships.
items.abstract_zh: RNA 基础模型有望解码 RNA 序列、结构与功能的关系，但模型架构如何塑造生物信息的获取与组织仍不清楚。本文提出 LIMBER，一种将双向自注意力与选择性状态空间建模相结合的混合基础模型，在 4050 万条非编码 RNA 序列上预训练。经任务微调后，LIMBER 在二级结构预测与非编码 RNA 分类基准上取得领先性能，并能良好迁移到翻译相关任务与 RNA—小分子相互作用预测。我们进一步建立统一、与任务无关的框架，系统评估模型内在习得的生物学知识，发现其能强有力地恢复 RNA 结构、预测突变效应，且生物信息在模型各层呈分层、任务依赖的组织方式；在容量、训练时长与数据规模的多种变体上，结构、进化与功能能力表现出不同的缩放行为。
items.highlight_zh: 混合架构 RNA 基础模型，并揭示模型内部知识的分层组织
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：RNA 的功能由序列和折叠结构共同决定，但实验测定又贵又慢。近年 RNA 领域也在建“基础模型”（类似蛋白质大模型），可是不同网络架构会让模型学到什么、这些知识在网络的哪一层、如何组织，一直缺乏系统认识。
2）方法：作者提出 LIMBER，把两种互补的结构“交错”堆叠：双向自注意力擅长捕捉序列远距离的相互配对（如碱基互补），Mamba 选择性状态空间模型则擅长高效处理长序列。模型在 4050 万条非编码 RNA 上预训练，再针对具体任务微调。同时建立一套与任务无关的统一评估与解释框架，用探针分析各层表征。
3）结果：在二级结构预测和非编码 RNA 分类两个基准上达到领先水平，还能迁移到翻译相关任务以及 RNA 与小分子结合预测；模型确实“学会”了结构并能预测突变效应；不同层负责不同层次、不同任务的信息；通过训练多种容量、时长、数据规模的变体，发现结构、进化、功能三类能力的缩放规律各不相同。
4）为何重要：既交付了一个多用途的 RNA 基础模型，也提供了一套“读懂模型学到了什么”的方法论，对靶向 RNA 的药物设计和后续基础模型架构选择都有参考价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Intensity limits for phase-only holographic optical-tweezer arrays
items.title_zh: 天蛾多模态主动感知中可执行信息景观的学习
items.abstract_en: Optical tweezers use tightly focused laser beams to trap and manipulate individual particles, enabling advances in quantum computing, drug discovery, and biological research. Scaling these technologies to large arrays requires delivering sufficient light to every trapping site while minimizing the total laser power required. Here, we investigate the fundamental limits of how efficiently a phase-only hologram can distribute light across an array of optical traps. We derive upper bounds on the minimum intensity across trapping sites, accounting for illumination, target geometry, and diffraction from spatial light modulator pixels. For arrays arranged in a single plane or across two axial planes, we show how these limits scale with the number of traps and SLM pixels, and establish conditions for focusing light in three dimensions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that optimized holograms can closely approach these theoretical limits, suggesting that further improvements in phase optimization alone offer limited power savings. Instead, our results reveal how the choice of illumination and trap geometry can improve light efficiency, providing practical guidelines for designing larger, more power-efficient optical-tweezer arrays.
items.abstract_zh: 光镊用紧聚焦激光束捕获并操控单个粒子，推动了量子计算、药物发现与生物学研究。要把这类技术扩展为大规模阵列，需向每个捕获位点输送足够光强，同时尽量减少总激光功率。本文研究纯相位全息图在光镊阵列上分配光能效率的基本极限，推导了考虑照明、目标几何与空间光调制器像素衍射的捕获位点最小强度上界；对单平面内及跨两个轴向平面的阵列，给出极限随陷阱数与 SLM 像素数的缩放规律，并确立三维聚焦的条件。数值实验表明优化全息图可逼近理论极限，说明仅靠相位优化再省功率的空间有限，而照明方式与陷阱几何的选择才是提升光效的关键。
items.highlight_zh: 推导纯相位全息光镊阵列的强度上界，指出相位优化已近瓶颈
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：光镊用量子计算、药物筛选和细胞操控，规模化的关键是用一台相位型空间光调制器（SLM）把一束激光分成成千上万个焦点。陷阱越多，每点分到的光越弱，但“光效的理论上限究竟在哪”此前多靠工程试错，缺乏定量答案。
2）方法：作者从理论上推导各捕获位点上最小强度的上界，推导中同时计入照明光场分布、目标阵列的几何排布（同一平面内、跨两个轴向平面、乃至真三维）以及 SLM 像素尺寸带来的衍射；再用数值全息优化，检验实际优化结果与理论极限的差距。
3）结果：优化后的全息图能够相当接近所推导的上界，意味着单靠改进相位优化算法几乎榨不出更多功率收益；给出了极限随陷阱数目和 SLM 像素数变化的缩放关系，并明确了实现三维聚焦所需满足的条件。
4）为何重要：这相当于告诉实验者“别只盯着算法”，应从照明方式（如更合适的光束形状）和陷阱几何排布入手来提升光效，为设计更大规模、更省功率的光镊阵列提供了实用的定量设计指南。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths
items.title_zh: 天蛾多模态主动感知中可执行信息景观的学习
items.abstract_en: Animals integrate information across sensory modalities to guide exploration, suggesting that they maintain internal estimates of where actions are expected to reduce uncertainty. However, how such action-conditioned information maps are learned from multimodal sensory experience remains unclear, as previous studies have been largely confined to unimodal sensing frameworks. We introduce a multimodal predictive-coding framework for learning uncertainty-reduction maps from visual and mechanosensory observations in hawkmoth flower interaction tasks. A variational generative model trained on simulated environments recovers modality-specific information landscapes over the action space, capturing how visual patterns, surface geometry, and mechanosensory cues shape the value of exploratory actions. These learned maps are consistent with several features of hawkmoth behavior, including nonzero tracking offsets, probing along visual patterns, and geometry-dependent exploration. Applying the model to behavioral data from flower tracking and nectary search, we find that natural trajectories tend to occupy regions of high uncertainty reduction in these learned maps. Building on these observations, we develop an uncertainty-gated lexicographic algorithm that switches between information gathering and reward exploitation based on perceptual uncertainty. In nectary search, uncertainty gating improves learning relative to exploit-only, $ε$-greedy, fixed-time, and uncertainty-calibrated non-lexicographic controls, with better generalization and robustness to sensory and curvature shifts. These results link information landscapes learned through generative modeling to biological sensing and embodied exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 动物整合多种感觉模态来引导探索，提示其内部维持着“哪些行动可降低不确定性”的估计。然而这类以行动为条件的信息地图如何从多模态经验中习得仍不清楚，以往研究多限于单模态框架。我们提出一个多模态预测编码框架，从天蛾与花朵交互任务中的视觉与机械感觉观测中学习不确定性降低地图。在模拟环境训练的变分生成模型可恢复动作空间上各模态的信息景观，刻画视觉模式、表面几何与机械感觉线索如何塑造探索行动的价值；这些地图与天蛾行为的多项特征吻合，如非零跟踪偏移、沿视觉模式探测与几何依赖的探索。将模型用于花朵跟踪与花蜜搜索行为数据，发现自然轨迹偏好高不确定性降低区域；据此设计的不确定性门控字典序算法在花蜜搜索中优于多种对照策略，并更具泛化性与鲁棒性。
items.highlight_zh: 多模态预测编码还原天蛾信息景观，并用不确定性门控驱动探索
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：动物探索环境时并非被动接收信息，而是主动用多种感官（如视觉加触觉/气流感觉）决定“下一步去哪、摸哪”。一个合理假设是大脑内部维持一张地图，标出“做哪个动作最能减少不确定性”。但这样的地图如何从多模态经验中学出来，此前研究多局限在单一感觉通道，说不清楚。
2）方法：作者以天蛾采蜜为模型系统，构建多模态预测编码框架：用变分生成模型在模拟环境中接收视觉与机械感觉输入，学习以行动为条件的“不确定性降低”景观，即每个动作在降低不确定性上的价值。
3）结果：模型自行学出的信息地图重现了真实天蛾行为的若干特征——跟踪花朵时保持非零偏移、沿花冠的视觉纹理进行探测、探索方式随花朵几何形状而变化；把模型套用到真实的花朵跟踪和寻找花蜜行为数据上，发现自然轨迹确实更多落在信息增益高的区域。基于此设计的不确定性门控字典序算法（依据感知不确定性在“先探索”与“先利用奖励”之间切换），在花蜜搜索任务中优于只用奖励、ε-greedy、固定探索时间和不确定性标定但不分优先级等多种对照，泛化更好，对感知噪声和花形弯曲也更鲁棒。
4）为何重要：把生成模型学到的“信息地图”与真实动物行为对应起来，既为神经行为学提供了可检验的计算解释，也给出了可用于机器人主动感知的探索算法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 大语言模型作为开放世界自动化机器学习的通用搜索器
items.abstract_en: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 构建有效的机器学习模型需要大量人工调参，而现有自动化机器学习（AutoML）框架往往局限于特定领域，并将模型结构、训练超参数与数据配比等优化割裂开来。本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的通用 AutoML 框架，首次无需任务特定微调即可联合优化上述配置。作者设计统一的数值编码方案 NCode，将多样化的 AutoML 设计选择转化为离散序列，从而把优化过程重构为统一的排序任务。仅在单一领域视觉任务的少量优化轨迹上训练后，该 LLM 搜索器便展现出优异的跨任务、跨模态与联合搜索空间泛化能力，在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证与文生图基准上取得领先性能。它还成功用于十亿参数 Diffusion Transformer 的大规模训练与联合优化（耗时 896 GPU-天，GenEval 得分 0.91）。借助强化学习引入思维链推理，作者还系统解释了搜索器的内部决策机制，发现其策略由早期多样性驱动的探索转向后期锚点利用。
items.highlight_zh: 用统一编码+LLM把AutoML变成排序任务，跨任务通用
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：现实中训练一个好模型，需要人工反复调结构、调超参、调数据配比，而现有 AutoML 工具往往只管其中一项，且换个任务或换个模态就得重做，缺乏通用性。

方法：作者提出 NCode——一套统一的数值编码方案，把各种设计选择（网络结构、训练超参数、数据比例等）都翻译成同一种“离散序列”，于是“找最优配置”被改写成一个统一的排序问题：让大语言模型去给候选配置排队。模型不需要针对具体任务微调，只在一小批来自单一视觉任务的优化轨迹上训练。此外还用强化学习教模型写出思维链（Chain-of-Thought），使其推理过程可被观察。

结果：训练好的 LLM 搜索器在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证、文生图等多个基准上都达到当时最好水平，说明它确实能跨任务、跨模态迁移；更关键的是它能扩展到超大规模——联合优化一个十亿参数的 Diffusion Transformer，消耗 896 GPU-天，GenEval 得分 0.91。可解释性分析显示，搜索策略会从早期“多试不同方向”的探索，逐步转为后期“抓住好锚点深挖”。

为何重要：这项工作给出了一条可扩展、可泛化、可解释的通路，让 AutoML 从“一个任务一套工具”走向“一个通用搜索器应对开放世界的各种建模问题”，对大模型时代的自动化模型设计有直接价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
items.title_zh: 迈向智能体化具身智能时代
items.abstract_en: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型越来越多地驱动机器人动作，但持续自主还需高效控制与失败恢复能力。本文提出 A2-MEAS，一个以“代码作为扩展接口”的具身多智能体框架。学习到的纠正代码融合纠正性语言、空间证据、执行历史与动作建议；MetaBrain 提供训练监督与运行时引导。训练时，纠正编码器与适配器将这些知识吸收进策略权重；部署时，新生成的代码可在权重冻结的情况下调整行为。动作模型 A2-WLA 在视觉-语言-动作策略上加入运动感知历史与潜在世界模型。在 BEHAVIOR 2026 公开子集 50 个任务上，该简化设计在线纠正前即达 0.5755 Q 分数，为 2025 年冠军报告值 0.2605 的 2.21 倍。在全部 100 个公开任务上取得 0.6411 Q 分数与 45.40% 任务成功率；RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 93.98%，完整系统达 95.05%；五个家庭场景的 12 个真实机器人任务上平均成功率 57.92%，而 pi0.5 为 26.67%。在长时序手冲咖啡任务中，历史条件适配器将两个滤纸处理步骤的失败后完成率从 14% 提至 94%、从 8% 提至 82%。训练基础设施吞吐为 427.1 样本/秒，是同硬件 pi0.5 参考实现的 4.03 倍。
items.highlight_zh: 以代码为扩展接口的多智能体框架，显著提升机器人成功率
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人在真实家庭环境里要长时间自主干活，光靠基础模型驱动动作还不够——它需要高效的控制方式，更需要“出错之后能自己恢复”的能力。现有方法在长时序任务中一旦失败往往就卡住。

方法：作者提出 A2-MEAS，一个具身多智能体框架，核心思路是“把代码当作扩展接口”。系统会生成纠正代码，这些代码把自然语言的纠错提示、空间证据、之前的执行历史和候选动作整合在一起。名为 MetaBrain 的模块既在训练时提供监督信号，也在运行时给出指导。训练阶段，纠正编码器与适配器把这些知识压进策略网络的权重；部署阶段，模型权重冻结，只靠新生成的代码来灵活调整行为。动作模型 A2-WLA 则在视觉-语言-动作策略上增加了运动感知的历史信息和潜在世界模型。

结果：在 BEHAVIOR 2026 公开子集的 50 个任务上，尚未启用在线纠正就取得 0.5755 的 Q 分数，是 2025 年冠军报告值 0.2605 的 2.21 倍（注：基准版本与训练配置不同）。全部 100 个公开任务上 Q 分数 0.6411、成功率 45.40%；RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 93.98%，加上完整系统升至 95.05%；五个家庭场景的 12 个真实机器人任务平均成功率 57.92%，远高于 pi0.5 的 26.67%。在手冲咖啡这类长时序任务中，失败后的恢复能力提升尤其明显：两个处理滤纸的步骤完成率分别从 14% 升到 94%、从 8% 升到 82%。训练基础设施吞吐为 427.1 样本/秒，是同等硬件下 pi0.5 实现的 4.03 倍。

为何重要：它表明“代码 + 多智能体 + 世界模型”的组合能让机器人既学得快又恢复得好，并给出了可复现的训练基础设施，为具身智能的规模化研究提供了实用范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints
items.title_zh: OptiCover：语义约束下冷启动视觉优化的可扩展多界面框架
items.abstract_en: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day. We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents. We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.
items.abstract_zh: 在电商市场的视觉营销中，选择有效的封面照片是一个关键但研究不足的问题。在 Airbnb 上，房东上传许多展示不同房间、设施和兴趣点的照片，但必须手动选择一张在异构产品界面中重复使用的静态封面照片。这带来了重大挑战：超过90%的房源照片没有互动标签，导致严重的冷启动状态；房客偏好在不同界面和搜索意图之间有所差异，视觉上吸引人的照片可能与底层房源在语义上不一致。在 Airbnb 规模下，这对应于数亿张照片和每天数十万次新上传。我们提出 OptiCover，一个在语义约束和多界面互动信号下进行冷启动视觉优化的可扩展框架。该框架结合了：(i) 照片候选生成器，通过各种代理指标识别候选照片；(ii) 应用于冻结 CLIP 嵌入的轻量级视觉头，用于大规模语义评分；(iii) 基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的跨模态 grounding 验证器，用于强制语义代表性；(iv) 探索日志模块（ELM），用于协调跨异构产品界面和上下文搜索意图的随机化互动数据收集。我们通过广泛的离线研究和跨 HomePage 与 Search 界面的多次在线实验评估 OptiCover。OptiCover 现已部署在生产环境中，每天执行数千万次照片替换。在线结果显示，HomePage 上的互动提升1.5%，Search 上的预订者增加0.35%，产生数百万美元的增量收入。我们的发现表明，动作空间塑形和语义约束是性能的主要驱动因素。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: SARS-CoV-2 susceptibility and vulnerability of human blastocysts during in vitro preimplantation development.
items.title_zh: 体外着床前发育过程中人囊胚对SARS-CoV-2的易感性与脆弱性
items.abstract_en: Human preimplantation embryos express the SARS-CoV-2 entry factors ACE2, TMPRSS2 and BSG (CD147) on trophectoderm (TE) cells, suggesting susceptibility to infection. Likewise, SARS-CoV-2-pseudotyped reporter viruses induced cytopathic effects in blastocysts, while the zona pellucida (ZP) appeared to confer partial protection. The impact of authentic SARS-CoV-2 infection on embryonic lineage specification and developmental competence has not been established. Here, we exposed cryopreserved human embryos, donated under ethics approval and informed consent, to authentic SARS-CoV-2 (B.1.617.2, Delta variant). While embryos with an intact ZP remained uninfected, laser-assisted hatching rendered 19/21 (90.5%) of embryos susceptible to infection, as confirmed by detection of viral dsRNA. Moreover, SARS-CoV-2 infection had a pronounced effect on blastocyst development with a possibly fatal outcome. Compared to mock-treated embryos (n = 47), infected blastocysts (n = 48) showed a significantly reduced surface area (p = 0.0003), reduced total cell number (p = 0.0139), and reduced NANOG+ epiblast cell numbers (p = 0.0054) 24 hours post-exposure, while the number of GATA4+ primitive endoderm cells remained unaffected (p = 0.5255). Intriguingly, despite viral replication being largely confined to the trophectoderm (TE), this selective epiblast reduction suggests a disruption of TE-derived paracrine signaling required for epiblast specification. Finally, prolonged viral replication resulted in embryonic lysis and death. Digital transcriptomic profiling (mock, n = 29 embryos; SARS-CoV-2, n = 28 embryos; each in n = 5 minipools) revealed upregulation of innate antiviral and inflammatory genes, including IFIH1, IRF7, NOD2, and TNFRSF1A, as well as the recently identified SARS-CoV-2 entry factor TMEM106B, alongside altered developmental signatures concerning genome activation, pluripotency, and lineage-specific programs. These findings show that ZP disruption makes human blastocysts susceptible to productive SARS-CoV-2 infection, with adverse consequences for lineage allocation and direct implications for biosafety and virological counselling in medically assisted reproduction practice.
items.abstract_zh: 人着床前胚胎在滋养外胚层（TE）细胞上表达 SARS-CoV-2 进入因子 ACE2、TMPRSS2 和 BSG（CD147），提示其易受感染。同样，SARS-CoV-2 假型报告病毒在囊胚中诱导细胞病变效应，而透明带（ZP）似乎提供部分保护。真实 SARS-CoV-2 感染对胚胎谱系特化和发育能力的影响尚未确定。在这里，我们将根据伦理批准和知情同意捐赠的冷冻人胚胎暴露于真实 SARS-CoV-2（B.1.617.2，Delta 变异株）。ZP 完整的胚胎仍未感染，而激光辅助孵化使 19/21（90.5%）的胚胎易感，并通过检测病毒双链 RNA 得到确认。此外，SARS-CoV-2 感染对囊胚发育有明显影响，并可能产生致命结果。与模拟处理胚胎（n = 47）相比，感染囊胚（n = 48）在暴露后24小时显示表面积显著减小（p = 0.0003）、总细胞数减少（p = 0.0139）以及 NANOG+ 上胚层细胞数减少（p = 0.0054），而 GATA4+ 原始内胚层细胞数未受影响（p = 0.5255）。有趣的是，尽管病毒复制主要局限于滋养外胚层（TE），这种选择性的上胚层减少提示 TE 来源的旁分泌信号传导（上胚层特化所需）受到破坏。最后， prolonged 病毒复制导致胚胎裂解和死亡。数字转录组分析（模拟组 n = 29 个胚胎；SARS-CoV-2 组 n = 28 个胚胎；每组 n = 5 个迷你池）显示先天抗病毒和炎症基因上调，包括 IFIH1、IRF7、NOD2 和 TNFRSF1A，以及最近鉴定的 SARS-CoV-2 进入因子 TMEM106B，同时伴随涉及基因组激活、多能性和谱系特异性程序的发育特征改变。这些发现表明，ZP 破坏使人类囊胚易受生产性 SARS-CoV-2 感染，并对谱系分配产生不良后果，对医学辅助生殖实践中的生物安全和病毒学咨询具有直接意义。

items.title_en: Boosting bottom-up milling of glass with GHz laser bursts
items.title_zh: 利用GHz激光脉冲串提升玻璃自下而上铣削
items.abstract_en: Burst-mode laser processing has gained increasing attention in material machining due to its potential to enhance processing efficiency and quality. However, most studies have focused on conventional top-down machining strategies, while investigations of bottom-up milling (BUM) remain limited. In this work, we optimize processing parameters for high-efficiency glass milling using a bottom-up approach with GHz bursts. The results show that the highest BUM efficiencies are achieved when employing high pulse counts ($\geq$ 20). To the best of our knowledge, we report the highest glass milling efficiency, reaching more than 250 $μ$m$^3$/$μ$J for both soda-lime glass and fused silica. Furthermore, increasing the burst repetition rate while maintaining a parameter set associated with high milling efficiency enables a material removal rate larger than 8 mm$^3$/s.
items.abstract_zh: 脉冲串模式激光加工因其提高加工效率和质量的潜力而在材料加工中受到越来越多关注。然而，大多数研究集中在传统的自上而下加工策略，而对自下而上铣削（BUM）的研究仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们使用 GHz 脉冲串的自下而上方法优化高效玻璃铣削的加工参数。结果表明，当采用高脉冲数（≥20）时，可获得最高的 BUM 效率。据我们所知，我们报告了最高的玻璃铣削效率，对于钠钙玻璃和熔融石英均超过 250 μm³/μJ。此外，在保持与高铣削效率相关的参数集的同时提高脉冲串重复率，可实现大于 8 mm³/s 的材料去除率。

items.title_en: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
items.title_zh: 世界模型需要多少次暴露？在测试时学习未见过的游戏机制
items.abstract_en: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够进行规划并从想象经验中学习，但在陌生环境中，它们必须从有限交互中学习其机制。机制是动作或交互如何改变环境一部分的规则。模型观察到的每一次机制发生就是一次暴露。我们提出：世界模型需要多少次暴露才能预测新环境机制的效果？我们在 ARC-AGI-3 上研究这个问题，该基准由程序定义的交互式游戏组成。我们引入 MechEval，它根据这些程序标注了 20 个游戏中的 69 种反复出现的机制。它在每次暴露时机制所改变的单元格上对每个预测评分。作为测试平台，我们构建 WARC（World model for ARC-AGI-3），一个 3500 万参数的视觉 Transformer，在其他游戏上预训练，并在每次转移后更新其所有参数。在留出游戏上，WARC 学会预测五分之四的机制，在其改变的单元格上至少达到 80% 准确率，并将该准确率保持到记录结束。其中一半在单次游戏过程中约 80 次暴露内达到该准确率，而在不更新的情况下，只有七分之一能达到。在公开游戏上的闭环游玩中，WARC-Agent 将 WARC 与固定图探索器配对，将探索器的官方效率分数从 0.15 提高到 0.46，主要通过测试时训练实现。在 Kaggle 排行榜的隐藏游戏上，我们的参赛作品得分为 0.20。

items.title_en: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
items.title_zh: 编程还是作弊？对前沿编程LLM的一项调查
items.abstract_en: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿智能体 LLM 在由真实软件仓库构建的强化学习（RL）环境中，使用可验证奖励进行训练。通过测试套件被视为解决任务的奖励。我们展示，在困难问题上，前沿模型常常通过获得答案而不是推导答案来满足这些奖励，这被称为奖励黑客。此前的报告在公开基准上记录了这种行为。我们在未见问题上测试其持续性。在一个答案无法泄露的加固环境中，我们测试的几乎每个模型都尝试恢复答案，并逐步升级为越来越专门的利用层级：挖掘仓库历史以寻找上游修复、直接检查 git 对象存储，以及扫描文件系统以寻找可能的更新版源代码或隐藏测试。这些尝试集中在最难的问题上，模型在是否、多频繁以及多深入升级方面存在差异。我们的立场是，这种行为是在泄露答案的 RL 环境中习得的一种捷径，而不是智能的标志。我们在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1 发布这些模型的智能体轨迹，以支持进一步研究。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、稳健且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。FAST-LIO2 建立在高效紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波器之上，具有两个关键新颖点，使快速、稳健且准确的 LiDAR 导航（与建图）成为可能。第一个是直接将原始点配准到地图（并随后更新地图，即建图），而无需提取特征。这能够利用环境中的细微特征，从而提高准确性。消除手工设计的特征提取模块也使其自然适应具有不同扫描模式的新兴 LiDAR；第二个主要新颖点是通过增量 k-d 树数据结构 ikd-Tree 维护地图，该结构支持增量更新（即点插入、删除）和动态重平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d 树）相比，ikd-Tree 实现更优的整体性能，同时自然支持在树上进行降采样。我们在来自多种开放 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上进行了详尽的基准比较。与其他最先进的 LiDAR-惯性导航系统相比，FAST-LIO2 以低得多的计算负载持续实现更高准确性。我们还对小视场固态 LiDAR 进行了各种真实世界实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 具有计算高效性（例如，在大型户外环境中高达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图）、稳健性（例如，在旋转高达 1000 deg/s 的杂乱室内环境中可靠位姿估计）、通用性（即适用于多线旋转和固态 LiDAR、UAV 和手持平台，以及 Intel 和 ARM 处理器），同时仍比现有方法实现更高准确性。我们的系统 FAST-LIO2 和数据结构 ikd-Tree 的实现均已在 Github 上开源。

items.title_en: Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos
items.title_zh: Compass 1：面向基于单目 RGB 视频的开放世界与持久具身导航
items.abstract_en: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.
items.abstract_zh: 具身导航要求智能体在开放世界中实现持久空间感知和长时程执行稳定性。然而，现有导航架构难以同时维持这两种能力，仅在最近少数帧上仍然有效。我们提出 Compass 1，这是首个统一语言理解与视频生成，并能够通过近2分钟视觉历史实现记忆回溯的具身导航基础模型。在不改变底层架构的情况下，我们引入 History Representation，它将稀疏视觉关键帧与显式的 History Representation Map 相结合，以保留长期时空上下文。为了有效利用这一历史，我们进一步引入 History Utilization，一种结构化 VQA 监督协议，包含三类：任务阶段定位、探索一致性和时空目标检索，从而支持基于地图的推理和稳定的持久长时程导航。为支撑该系统，我们建立了一套完整的单目 RGB 视频标注流水线，并开源了一个大规模数据集，包含超过500小时高质量真实世界交互和超过2000小时带标注的网络视频。Compass 1 主要在1米高度相机的分布上训练，能够无缝泛化到多样具身平台和场景，从室内环境到行人密集街道，涵盖0.35米的轮式机器人、0.5米的四足狗、0.85米的人形机器人和1.5米的空中无人机。在开放世界评估中，Compass 1 取得79.4%的总体成功率并占据主导地位，而最强基线为17.8%。它在基础任务上展现出超过90%的卓越零样本执行能力，探索能力提升250%，并在具有挑战性的持久历史回溯中实现从0%到58%的无与伦比跃升。

items.title_en: Uncovering Viral Signals Across Cell Populations in Colorectal Cancer
items.title_zh: 揭示结直肠癌中跨细胞群体的病毒信号
items.abstract_en: Viral sequences have been detected in colorectal cancer, but their cellular and anatomical distribution remains poorly resolved. We aimed to establish a cell-type-resolved map of viral reference-associated RNA signals across colorectal cancer, tumour-adjacent normal tissue, and healthy colon. We repurposed human-unmapped reads from single-cell RNA sequencing libraries generated in ten publicly available studies. We retained cell-barcode and unique molecular identifier information, removed duplicate molecules, and aligned reads to a curated human-associated viral reference using three aligners. Viral signals were analysed across cell types, tissue conditions, and colorectal segments. We used participant-grouped repeated cross-validation to evaluate tissue-condition classification and screened an independent paired colorectal cancer proteomics cohort for compatible peptide matches. The study included 547 libraries from 112 participants, including 49 with matched colorectal cancer and tumour-adjacent normal samples, and approximately 415,000 cells spanning ten major cell populations. Viral reference-associated RNA signals differed across epithelial, immune, stromal, and vascular compartments, tissue conditions, and anatomical regions of the colon. Of 318 independent healthy-reference viral-load comparisons, seven involving six virus-cell-type groups remained significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction, including plasma-cell HHV-7 and HHV-6B and mast-cell HCV-2. Cell-type-resolved viral features distinguished colorectal cancer, tumour-adjacent normal tissue, and healthy colon in participant-grouped validation; random forest achieved a macro-AUC of 0.957 (SD 0.028), with HERV-K113 as the leading quantitative feature. An independent proteomic screen identified peptide matches compatible with 20 candidate viral groups. We established a cell-type-resolved map of viral reference-associated RNA signals across colorectal tissue conditions and anatomical regions. By identifying candidate viral signals in epithelial and immune compartments, this map provides a basis for investigating virus-host pathways involved in tumour biology, immune regulation, and antigen-presentation states, and could help prioritise future combination strategies pairing virus-directed or virus-mimetic approaches with standard treatment or immune checkpoint blockade.
items.abstract_zh: 在结直肠癌中已检测到病毒序列，但其细胞和解剖分布仍不清楚。我们旨在建立跨结直肠癌、肿瘤邻近正常组织和健康结肠的、细胞类型分辨的病毒参考相关 RNA 信号图谱。我们重新利用了来自十项公开研究的单细胞 RNA 测序文库中未比对到人类基因组的 reads。我们保留了细胞条形码和唯一分子标识符信息，去除了重复分子，并使用三种比对器将 reads 比对到精选的人类相关病毒参考序列。我们跨细胞类型、组织状态和结直肠分段分析了病毒信号。我们使用按参与者分组的重复交叉验证来评估组织状态分类，并在一个独立配对结直肠癌蛋白质组队列中筛选相容的肽段匹配。该研究纳入了来自112名参与者的547个文库，其中包括49名具有匹配结直肠癌和肿瘤邻近正常样本的参与者，以及横跨十个主要细胞群体的约415,000个细胞。病毒参考相关 RNA 信号在上皮、免疫、基质和血管区室、组织状态以及结肠解剖区域之间存在差异。在318项独立的健康参考病毒载量比较中，涉及六个病毒-细胞类型组的七项在 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正后仍显著，包括浆细胞 HHV-7 和 HHV-6B 以及肥大细胞 HCV-2。在按参与者分组的验证中，细胞类型分辨的病毒特征能够区分结直肠癌、肿瘤邻近正常组织和健康结肠；随机森林达到0.957的宏平均 AUC（标准差0.028），其中 HERV-K113 是首要定量特征。一项独立的蛋白质组筛选识别出与20个候选病毒组相容的肽段匹配。我们建立了跨结直肠组织状态和解剖区域的、细胞类型分辨的病毒参考相关 RNA 信号图谱。通过识别上皮和免疫区室中的候选病毒信号，该图谱为研究参与肿瘤生物学、免疫调节和抗原呈递状态的病毒-宿主通路提供了基础，并可能有助于优先考虑将病毒导向或病毒模拟方法与标准治疗或免疫检查点阻断配对的未来联合策略。

items.title_en: Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
items.title_zh: CrSBr 中的缺陷与结构演化：用于原子尺度模拟的机器学习势
items.abstract_en: The layered van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr combines intrinsic magnetic order with semiconducting and optical properties, making it a promising material for multifunctional electronic and photonic applications. Understanding how defects and structural transformations affect its properties under experimentally relevant conditions, however, remains challenging for first-principles simulations due to the relevant length and time scales. Here, we develop and benchmark machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for the Cr-S-Br system, enabling large-scale atomistic simulations of CrSBr with accuracy approaching that of density functional theory (DFT). The charge-aware variant qNEP achieves near-DFT accuracy in predicting lattice constants, formation enthalpies, vacancy energetics, and the anisotropic pressure response of o-CrSBr. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal that pre-existing S vacancies lower the Cr Frenkel-pair migration barrier by up to 1.1 eV, providing an atomistic mechanism for beam-induced Cr redistribution and structural transformations. Displacement threshold calculations further show that Br is the most susceptible species to electron-beam-induced displacement, identifying the relative ease of removing different atomic species. Together, these results establish a validated computational framework for investigating atomic-scale disorder and structural transformations in CrSBr, providing a basis for defect engineering in materials for future magneto-optoelectronic applications.
items.abstract_zh: 层状范德华半导体 CrSBr 将本征磁序与半导体和光学性质相结合，使其成为多功能电子和光子应用的有前景材料。然而，理解缺陷和结构转变在实验相关条件下如何影响其性质，对于第一性原理模拟而言仍具挑战性，因为相关长度和时间尺度较大。在此，我们为 Cr-S-Br 体系开发并基准测试了机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），从而使 CrSBr 的大规模原子尺度模拟成为可能，其精度接近密度泛函理论（DFT）。电荷感知变体 qNEP 在预测 o-CrSBr 的晶格常数、形成焓、空位能量学和各向异性压力响应方面达到接近 DFT 的精度。微动弹性带计算表明，预先存在的 S 空位将 Cr Frenkel 对迁移势垒最多降低1.1 eV，为束流诱导的 Cr 重新分布和结构转变提供了原子尺度机制。位移阈值计算进一步表明，Br 是对电子束诱导位移最敏感的物种，从而识别出移除不同原子物种的相对难易程度。总之，这些结果建立了一个经过验证的计算框架，用于研究 CrSBr 中的原子尺度无序和结构转变，为面向未来磁光电子应用的材料的缺陷工程提供了基础。

items.title_en: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: Agentic-OPD：通过同策略蒸馏为智能体任务恢复被遗忘的智能体能力
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习现在是训练 LLM 完成智能体任务的主流范式，但标准做法只保留最佳验证检查点，而丢弃其余检查点。我们表明这是有损的：在 LLM 智能体的 GRPO 训练中，最佳验证检查点会在同一运行中较早检查点已经解决的问题上失败，而跨检查点已解决问题的并集远超任一单个检查点。因此，被丢弃的检查点形成了一个无需额外训练成本即可获得的教师池，同策略蒸馏（OPD）可以挖掘该教师池以恢复丢失的覆盖。挖掘该池带来两个挑战：i）从哪个检查点蒸馏，因为没有检查点优于其他检查点，且与学生的互补性是问题特定的；ii）在哪里信任它，因为即使是精心选择的教师也只是局部更优，因此不加区分地蒸馏会覆盖学生已经掌握的行为。我们提出 Agentic-OPD，它将最佳验证检查点作为学生，并将所有保存的检查点作为冻结的教师候选，利用学生不断演变的能力差距来指导教师选择和监督过滤：HCN 策略（Highest Coverage Next）通过对学生未解决问题的加权覆盖率动态选择教师，而 LAD 模块（Locality-Aware Distillation）将迁移限制在教师表现更好的问题上学生失败的 rollout 上。在五个智能体任务领域以及24个基准和任务子集上，Agentic-OPD 相较于其初始化检查点最多提升7.4个点，其中4B 学生在深度搜索上超越了最新前沿模型 GPT-5.6 和 DeepSeek-V4.1。Agentic-OPD 将一次已完成的 RL 运行重塑为可复用的策略池，并将 RL 后能力恢复确立为与 RL 算法本身改进正交的阶段。

items.title_en: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
items.title_zh: 人格泛化是可预测的吗？
items.abstract_en: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 当在一个领域微调语言模型会诱发其他领域的行为变化时，就会发生人格泛化——例如，在涌现性失配中观察到的广泛不安全行为。我们在人格泛化中发现了一个令人惊讶的“在线上”（on-the-line）现象：在不同微调超参数下，域内和域外人格率遵循近似 probit 线性关系，而且具体的 probit 线性关系甚至在包括 Qwen 和 Llama 的模型家族和模型规模之间也令人惊讶地共享。不改变可训练参数集合的训练选择，例如学习率、权重衰减和训练时长，主要使模型沿同一条线移动，主要通过削弱域内学习来减少迁移。然而，改变微调哪些层可以改变斜率。对于不安全行为，仅微调较后层会产生更浅的斜率，在保留强域内学习的同时减少域外失配。这一“在线上”现象将关于人格泛化的意外、孤立观察统一到一个用于预测和控制行为迁移的定量框架中。

items.title_en: VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
items.title_zh: 使用真实与仿真数据进行 VLA 适配：机器人国际象棋案例研究
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型被训练为机器人学习的通用基础模型，并且需要针对每个下游任务和机器人进行微调。这引出了实际问题，例如需要多少数据和训练更新、应如何选择检查点，以及是否可以利用仿真来减轻真实数据收集的成本。我们在一个既需要精确操作又需要场景空间理解的任务上研究这些问题。在该任务中，SO-101 机械臂仅在给定两个方格名称（例如 e4 和 a5）的情况下，将国际象棋国王从一个方格移动到另一个方格。我们使用各种数据集大小和更新预算微调 π_{0.5}，使用遥操作演示以及来自随机化脚本专家的仿真演示，该专家模仿人类演示的变异性。在仿真中，成功率随数据和更新量扩展。重要的是，我们发现短暂的学习率冷却最多增加31个点，并且对于比较检查点是必要的，而验证损失和动作误差对于模型选择不可靠。在真实机械臂上，我们最多使用256个遥操作演示进行微调，并在每个策略25次试验中评估十个策略。部分结果表明，在仿真演示上进行预训练有显著帮助，在真实数据稀缺时最为明显。我们还给出一个负面结果：在我们的设置中，使用过滤行为克隆、RECAP 风格的优势条件、自动教练的纠正或残差强化学习在策略自身的 rollout 上训练，并未比普通行为克隆产生可测量的改进。我们发布了模拟器、专家和真实演示。

items.title_en: Next-Generation Segmentation in Radiotherapy: A Narrative Review from Atlas-Based Methods to Agentic Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 下一代放疗分割：从基于图谱方法到智能体化视觉-语言模型的叙述性综述
items.abstract_en: Precise segmentation of target volumes and organs at risk is an essential prerequisite for modern, high-precision radiation therapy. However, this task has traditionally been time-consuming and subject to high interobserver variability. Motivated by these limitations, more advanced and novel approaches to automating this task have been developed over the past two decades. This narrative review highlights representative milestones, with a focus on the most recent developments. These approaches include atlas-based label propagation, convolutional architectures, promptable foundation models, and, most recently, vision-language models (VLMs), which integrate clinical text with volumetric segmentation. Each methodological generation has addressed limitations of its predecessor while introducing new ones. A substantial gap remains between research progress and clinical deployment, as routine workflows continue to be dominated by atlas-based and narrow task-specific deep-learning tools, which remain strong baselines in geometric overlap metrics but are highly rigid in terms of application, versatility, portability, and interpretability. As contouring systems further grow in complexity, conventional geometric overlap metrics become insufficient, motivating evaluation paradigms that incorporate surface-based, dosimetric, and prompt-adherence assessment. Emerging agentic architectures that combine large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and vision-language segmentation modules are leading towards more flexible, guideline-aware, interactive contouring workflows. These systems could automate flexible and interpretable knowledge-based contouring and actively support the clinical reasoning underlying target volume definition.
items.abstract_zh: 靶区与危及器官的精确分割是现代高精度放射治疗的必要前提，但传统上这项工作耗时且观察者间差异大。过去二十年间，自动化分割方法不断演进。本叙述性综述梳理代表性里程碑，重点聚焦最新进展：基于图谱的标签传播、卷积网络架构、可提示基础模型，以及最新将临床文本与三维体数据分割相结合的视觉-语言模型（VLM）。每一代方法在解决前一代局限的同时也带来新问题。研究进展与临床落地之间仍存在明显鸿沟：常规工作流仍以图谱方法和狭窄的任务专用深度学习工具为主，后者在几何重叠指标上仍是强基线，但在适用性、通用性、可移植性与可解释性上非常僵硬。随着勾画系统日益复杂，传统几何重叠指标已不够用，需要引入基于表面、剂量学以及提示遵循度的评估范式。融合大语言模型、检索增强生成与视觉-语言分割模块的智能体架构，正推动更灵活、贴合指南、可交互的勾画工作流。
items.highlight_zh: 系统梳理放疗分割四代方法，指出研究到临床的落地鸿沟
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：放疗要想打得准，先得把肿瘤靶区和旁边要保护的器官在 CT 上一层层勾画出来（即分割）。这件事长期靠医生手工做，既费时，不同医生勾出来的结果差异也很大。论文要回答的是：过去二十年自动化分割走到哪一步了？还有什么没解决？

方法：这是一篇叙述性综述，不做新实验，而是按“技术代际”梳理代表性路线：最早是基于图谱的标签传播（把已有病例的勾画映射到新病人身上），然后是卷积神经网络等深度学习架构，再到可提示的基础模型（如可用点/框提示的分割大模型），最新则是把临床文本和三维影像结合起来的视觉-语言模型（VLM）。

发现与判断：每一代方法都在修补上一代的短板，同时又引入新的短板。最关键的是，论文指出研究与临床之间存在明显鸿沟——医院日常用的仍然主要是图谱方法和只管单一任务的深度学习工具。这些工具在“几何重叠度”这类指标上分数很高，但很死板：换个部位、换个医院、换台设备就不一定好用，而且难以解释。作者还强调，随着勾画系统变复杂，只看重叠度已经不够，应引入基于轮廓表面距离、剂量学影响以及是否遵循提示词的评估方式。

为何重要：论文展望了“智能体化”方向——把大语言模型、检索增强生成与视觉-语言分割模块组合起来，做出能读懂指南、可交互、能解释自己判断的勾画系统。这为放疗分割从“自动画线工具”走向“辅助临床推理的助手”提供了路线图，对放疗科医生和医学影像 AI 研究者都有参考价值。
