items.title_en: Memory traces bias new learning for hippocampal generalization
items.title_zh: 记忆痕迹使新学习产生偏倚以支持海马泛化
items.abstract_en: Generalizing prior experience to guide behavior in novel situations is a fundamental cognitive function, yet how this occurs remains poorly understood. Here we combined longitudinal imaging in mice with modeling and circuit perturbation to examine generalization in hippocampal CA1 across environments with shared task structure. Prior training accelerated behavioral adaptation and preserved cross-environment representations. We identified putative memory traces associated with generalization. At the cellular level, spatially informative residual activity reflecting generalizable information biased which neurons formed place fields (PFs) and where via behavioral timescale synaptic plasticity (BTSP). At the population level, BTSP was associated with rapid alignment of novel-environment network dynamics to familiar neural subspaces. Chemogenetic suppression of local CA1 during training reduced residual activity, BTSP induction, place cell recruitment and generalization. In sum, the influence of memory traces on new PF formation may allow past experience to guide new learning to form representations based on generalizable features.
items.abstract_zh: 将先前经验泛化以指导新情境中的行为是一项基本认知功能，但其发生机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们将小鼠纵向成像与建模和回路扰动相结合，在具有共享任务结构的不同环境中考察海马CA1的泛化。先前训练加速了行为适应并保留了跨环境表征。我们识别出与泛化相关的推定记忆痕迹。在细胞层面，反映可泛化信息的具有空间信息性的残余活动，通过行为时间尺度突触可塑性（BTSP）偏倚了哪些神经元形成位置野（PFs）以及在哪里形成。在群体层面，BTSP与新环境网络动力学快速对齐到熟悉的神经子空间相关。训练期间对局部CA1进行化学遗传学抑制，减少了残余活动、BTSP诱导、位置细胞募集和泛化。总之，记忆痕迹对新PF形成的影响可能使过去经验引导新学习，以基于可泛化特征形成表征。

items.title_en: Modular and Looping Quantum Photonic Processing Unit for Quantum Computing
items.title_zh: 用于量子计算的模块化循环量子光子处理单元
items.abstract_en: Photonic processors are emerging as promising platforms in the race towards the realization of practical universal quantum computers. Several architectures with universal capabilities have been proposed for their implementation via a photonic platform, each with their own set of benefits and drawbacks. In this work we propose an architecture for a universal photonic quantum computer. The proposed architecture is modular, allowing for a high degree of flexibility and scalability, and relies on a loop-based structure, significantly reducing the number of physical components required to implement it experimentally. We prove that our architecture is universal, deterministic, and compatible with the quantum circuital model, as well as reprogrammable and capable of adaptive measurements. Furthermore, we showcase its functioning via numerical simulation on specific examples, by using machine learning techniques on a set of fundamental linear and nonlinear optical components to obtain some of the building blocks used in the architecture. The obtained results can be used to highlight the benefits and the drawbacks of the proposed architecture, as well as the route for future developments towards its physical implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 光子处理器正在成为实现实用通用量子计算机竞赛中有前景的平台。已有若干具有通用能力的架构被提出以通过光子平台实现，每种架构各有优缺点。在本工作中，我们提出一种通用光子量子计算机的架构。所提架构是模块化的，具有高度灵活性和可扩展性，并依赖基于环的结构，显著减少了实验实现所需的物理组件数量。我们证明该架构具有通用性、确定性，与量子电路模型兼容，并且可重编程且能够进行自适应测量。此外，我们通过对具体示例进行数值模拟展示其运行，在一组基本线性和非线性光学组件上使用机器学习技术，以获得该架构中使用的部分构建模块。所得结果可用于突出所提架构的优点和缺点，以及未来走向物理实现的发展路径。

items.title_en: Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets
items.title_zh: 智能手机赋能的深度感知透照成像用于检测鸡胸肉片中的肌病
items.abstract_en: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.
items.abstract_zh: 木胸（WB）肌病是肉鸡中的主要质量缺陷，以纤维化、组织硬度增加和影响产品质量的结构特性改变为特征。传统触诊主观且劳动密集，而许多无损方法需要专用设备或大量计算资源。本研究开发了一种基于智能手机的透照和三维点云框架，用于无损WB严重程度分类。共267块鸡胸肉片，包括正常胸肉（NB，n = 87）、轻度WB（MWB，n = 85）和重度WB（SWB，n = 95），使用iPhone 16 Pro采集的RAW透照图像和三维点云进行评估。共提取91个特征，包括14个图像衍生特征、76个几何特征和1个物理信息驱动的Beer-Lambert衰减特征。控制厚度的偏相关分析显示图像特征与WB严重程度之间存在显著关联（r = 0.413，p < 0.0001），表明光学信息独立于肉片几何形状。SWB组织每单位厚度的光衰减比NB约高26%。仅2D模型达到约82%的测试准确率，而结合Fusion-DGCNN、XGBoost和物理引导逻辑回归（PGLR）的多模态集成达到约90%的准确率。这些发现证明了光学、几何和物理信息特征的互补价值，并确立了基于智能手机的无损WB严重程度评估的可行性。

items.title_en: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
items.title_zh: PORT：通过稳健的标记级重加权进行偏好优化
items.abstract_en: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
items.abstract_zh: 偏好优化已成为使大语言模型与人类价值观对齐的核心方法，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于偏好标注的质量。实践中，偏好数据常因标注错误和歧义而存在噪声。现有稳健偏好优化方法主要在序列层面操作，隐含地将整个响应视为一致正确或错误。然而，被拒绝的响应仍可能包含有信息量的推理步骤，而被偏好的响应可能包含细微错误。在本工作中，我们提出PORT，一种在噪声偏好下进行稳健对齐的细粒度框架。PORT使用标记对数概率的经验累积分布函数（CDF）进行标记级重加权，产生一种仅需前向传播的高效梯度范数惩罚代理，可选择性地抑制受污染标记，而无需额外反向传播计算。我们提供理论分析，表明PORT通过最小化偏置项的上界，减少来自噪声偏好标签的梯度偏置。在多种噪声设置下的大量实验表明，PORT持续提高稳健性并优于现有序列级基线。代码见 https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT。

items.title_en: Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation
items.title_zh: 面向语言条件双臂操作的任务规划与执行衔接
items.abstract_en: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.
items.abstract_zh: 人们越来越期望机器人在真实环境中执行自然语言操作任务。这在家庭辅助和物流中尤为相关，其中杂乱环境需要同时推理任务目标和执行可行性。对于双臂人形平台，这一挑战更为突出，因为协调两个操作器会引入额外的交互和运动学约束。我们提出一种零样本视觉-语言框架，用于执行感知的双臂操作，联合推理任务目标和物理可行性。规划基于结构化场景表示，该表示结合语义对象关系与执行约束，从而能够在保持任务语义的同时选择障碍物移动和执行方案。兼容动作被组织为具有显式前置和后置条件的并行双臂阶段。分层验证器在感知不确定性下评估这些条件，并使用阶段级执行历史支持局部恢复或针对性重规划。在CENTAURO混合轮腿人形机器人上跨九个语言条件操作场景的实验显示，任务成功率高于非执行感知基线。在专门的失败场景中，分层验证从执行失败中恢复所需的模型查询次数少于始终重规划。这些结果证明了将执行推理直接结合到任务规划中的益处。视频和附加材料见项目网页：https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/。

items.title_en: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
items.title_zh: 通过球面光束法平差引导的无监督深度估计学习实现尺度一致的单目鱼眼视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼眼相机的宽视场和单目设置的简洁性，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）对机器人定位与建图具有吸引力。然而，尺度漂移在长轨迹中仍是主要挑战。无监督深度估计学习有助于缓解该问题，但鱼眼图像的显著畸变对准确深度估计构成挑战。本文提出 S$^2$D-FVO，一个集成球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度估计学习的单目鱼眼 VO 框架，以提高尺度一致性和深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差不能一致地反映视线之间的角度偏差，且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿某一切线方向的扰动不敏感，SBA 采用由球面对数映射导出的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切线方向上均保持敏感性，其范数等于相应的标量角度残差。进一步将基于中值深度的尺度正则化项集成到 SBA 中，以约束重建尺度。基于这些公式，SBA 在无监督深度估计学习过程中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络提供的深度估计为 SBA 提供尺度参考，在提高尺度一致性的同时允许细化单个三维地标位置。在多个公共数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型。

items.title_en: Illuminating the Role of A-to-I Editing in Cancer using EndoVIA 2.0
items.title_zh: 利用 EndoVIA 2.0 揭示 A-to-I 编辑在癌症中的作用
items.abstract_en: Adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) RNA editing is an essential post-transcriptional modification catalyzed by adenosine deaminases acting on RNA (ADAR) enzymes, and emerging evidence suggests its dysregulation can contribute to cancer. However, technical barriers have hindered spatial analysis of editing activity in formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues - an abundant but challenging sample type. Here, we introduce EndoVIA 2.0, an optimized immunostaining assay that enables quantification and spatial mapping of edited RNAs in FFPE tissues. Using human Endonuclease V (hEndoV) as a molecular affinity reagent, we developed a calcium-dependent staining workflow compatible with crosslinked tissues. EndoVIA 2.0 was validated in cell lines having altered ADAR1 expression, fresh frozen (FF) tissues, gastric organoids, and FFPE tissue sections. Using quantitative imaging combined with machine-learning segmentation and spatial analysis, EndoVIA 2.0 successfully detected A-to-I editing changes in ADAR1 knockout (KO) and overexpression models, revealing differential editing patterns across tissues. In gastric organoids and FFPE tissues, the assay also spatially resolved editing heterogeneity and distinguished ADAR1-deficient from ADAR1-sufficient cells. Application to long-archived lung and breast cancer FFPE tissues suggest EndoVIA 2.0's broad utility and potential for capturing disease-associated changes in A-to-I editing. Finally, staining across the gastric neoplastic cascade revealed stage-dependent increases in A-to-I editing and changes in subcellular localization, further supporting the possibility that ADAR plays a critical role in the early development of gastric cancer. EndoVIA 2.0 enables robust, spatial detection of A-to-I editing in FFPE tissues - circumventing the limitations of RNA extraction and unlocking access to archived clinical specimens. This platform lays the foundation for mapping RNA editing dynamics in cancer progression and may support future biomarker discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 腺苷至肌苷（A-to-I）RNA 编辑是由作用于 RNA 的腺苷脱氨酶（ADAR）催化的一种重要转录后修饰，新出现的证据表明其失调可促成癌症。然而，技术障碍阻碍了对福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）组织中编辑活性的空间分析——FFPE 是一种丰富但具有挑战性的样本类型。在此，我们介绍 EndoVIA 2.0，一种优化的免疫染色检测方法，可对 FFPE 组织中的编辑 RNA 进行定量和空间定位。使用人核酸内切酶 V（hEndoV）作为分子亲和试剂，我们开发了与交联组织兼容的钙依赖性染色流程。EndoVIA 2.0 在 ADAR1 表达改变的细胞系、新鲜冷冻（FF）组织、胃类器官和 FFPE 组织切片中得到了验证。利用定量成像结合机器学习分割和空间分析，EndoVIA 2.0 成功检测到 ADAR1 敲除（KO）和过表达模型中的 A-to-I 编辑变化，揭示了组织间的差异编辑模式。在胃类器官和 FFPE 组织中，该检测还空间分辨了编辑异质性，并区分了 ADAR1 缺陷细胞与 ADAR1 充足细胞。将其应用于长期存档的肺癌和乳腺癌 FFPE 组织，表明 EndoVIA 2.0 具有广泛用途以及捕获 A-to-I 编辑中疾病相关变化的潜力。最后，在胃肿瘤发生级联中的染色揭示了 A-to-I 编辑的分期依赖性增加以及亚细胞定位变化，进一步支持 ADAR 在胃癌早期发展中起关键作用的可能性。EndoVIA 2.0 能够在 FFPE 组织中稳健地空间检测 A-to-I 编辑——规避 RNA 提取的局限，并使存档临床标本可供使用。该平台为绘制癌症进展中的 RNA 编辑动态奠定了基础，并可能支持未来的生物标志物发现。

items.title_en: Long-distance quantum secure direct communication with Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill qubits
items.title_zh: 使用 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill 量子比特的长距离量子安全直接通信
items.abstract_en: The Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) code possesses a lattice periodic structure that enables the effective correction of small displacement errors induced by noise in phase space, which is indispensable for quantum computation. The GKP code was also used to construct a long-distance entanglement channel in quantum repeaters and distribute random keys in quantum key distribution (QKD). Using GKP encoding, we propose a quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) protocol that not only transmits the secret message directly, but also helps protect the safety of communication personnel. The exponential attenuation loss of photons can be overcome by the third-generation quantum repeater. Numerical simulation results demonstrate that secure transmission distance exceeding 1000 km is achievable with a 23 dB squeezing level. Furthermore, we establish a cost-based optimization framework to characterize the trade-off among secure communication distance, secrecy capacity, and repeater resources, enabling optimized repeater deployment and providing a systematic design strategy for scalable quantum repeater architectures. The results demonstrate the potential of combining GKP error correction for long-distance QSDC and quantum networks.
items.abstract_zh: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill（GKP）码具有晶格周期结构，能够有效纠正相空间中噪声引起的小位移误差，这对量子计算不可或缺。GKP 码也被用于在量子中继器中构建长距离纠缠信道，以及在量子密钥分发（QKD）中分发随机密钥。利用 GKP 编码，我们提出一种量子安全直接通信（QSDC）协议，不仅直接传输秘密消息，还有助于保护通信人员的安全。光子的指数衰减损耗可由第三代量子中继器克服。数值模拟结果表明，在 23 dB 压缩水平下可实现超过 1000 km 的安全传输距离。此外，我们建立了一个基于成本的优化框架，以刻画安全通信距离、保密容量和中继器资源之间的权衡，从而实现优化中继器部署，并为可扩展量子中继器架构提供系统设计策略。结果表明，将 GKP 纠错结合用于长距离 QSDC 和量子网络具有潜力。

items.title_en: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
items.title_zh: $\Sigma$-LeWM：通过 S-信息学习用于机器人控制的世界模型
items.abstract_en: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用作基于模型的控制方法，用于操作和移动等机器人任务。早期世界模型架构依赖解码器来防止模式坍塌并学习可预测的潜在空间，而近期的世界模型工作，如联合嵌入预测架构或 LeWorldModel，越来越多地旨在不使用接地解码器的情况下学习嵌入，仅利用潜在前向动力学预测器和稳定化熵项。本文旨在证明，向 LeWorldModel 进一步引入两个额外的潜在损失——反向动力学预测器和逆向动力学动作预测器——会对潜在嵌入施加更多结构，从而在性能和规划效率上取得进一步提升。这些是提高此类方法对真实机器人实时基于模型控制适用性的关键特性。我们在标准世界模型基准和两个模拟机器人操作任务上展示了这些增益。

items.title_en: A Cost That Practice Accuracy Hides: Worked Solutions in Self-Generated Training Data and the Compositional Use of New Rules
items.title_zh: 练习准确率所掩盖的代价：自生成训练数据中的详细解答与新规则的组合使用
items.abstract_en: A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.
items.abstract_zh: 详细解答可使自生成训练目标更短、成本更低，但对练习操作的准确率可能掩盖模型复用新学规则的能力。我们在一个 20 亿参数的推理模型中研究这一选择，该模型学习两条虚构的定量规则。模型仅从规则表或从规则表加程序编写的详细解答生成目标；仅当最终答案正确时接受目标，并在微调和评估时移除支撑材料。训练问题要求在一个片段中正向使用；组合要求在兩個片段中顺序复用同一规则。经过六遍后，使用程序校验的数值签名，仅规则表目标在前瞻性测试的组合任务上领先 24.3 个百分点（95% 条目自助法置信区间 14.6–34.0）。在未见参数值上，观察到的正向准确率相同（各为 87.5%），但组合准确率为 58.3% 对 23.6%，相差 34.7 个百分点（25.7–43.8）。独立采样的第二目标库对重复了该方向（+14.6 个百分点，2.1–26.0）。在较短的详细解答目标上训练十遍，约匹配六遍仅规则表训练的领域 token 数，同时改变其他训练量，将差距缩小至第一目标库对的 16.3 个百分点（6.3–26.7）和第二目标库对的 6.2 个百分点（-6.3 至 18.8），后者预先设定的检验不成立。在各自六遍时，详细解答策略使用更少的捕获 token 和更短的更新用时，然而训练后的模型在数值签名下每次组合成功使用 2.6 倍的生成 token（第二目标库对为 2.1 倍）。因此，选择捕获上下文时，需要测试新规则如何被复用，以及这些使用方式的推理成本，而不能仅依赖正向准确率。

items.title_en: PCTac: Mechanochromic Photonic-Crystal Tactile Sensor for Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: PCTac：用于灵巧操作的力致变色光子晶体触觉传感器
items.abstract_en: Modern visuotactile sensors primarily sense contact by imaging the deformation of a compliant interface. Using techniques such as photometric stereo, they can recover detailed contact geometry, often represented as surface normals or depth. However, force-related information typically still needs to be inferred indirectly through calibration, geometric reconstruction, or learned mappings. Mechanochromic photonic-crystal (PC) materials offer an alternative physical encoding mechanism: contact loading changes their periodic microstructure and spectral response, directly transforming local stress into a spatially resolved structural-color field. Despite this potential, PC materials have rarely been explored as visuotactile sensors for closed-loop robot learning. We present PCTac, an open-source mechanochromic PC fingertip that uses a dense hue field as its tactile observation. Loading characterization demonstrates a repeatable relationship between the applied normal load and the observed hue response. We further integrate this representation directly into a Diffusion Policy and evaluate it on three real-robot manipulation tasks. Across 90 physical rollouts, PCTac Hue achieves 68 successes (75.6\%), compared with 60 (66.7\%) for PCTac RGB, 57 (63.3\%) for Wedge RGB, and 29 (32.2\%) for vision-only. PCTac Hue also achieves the highest observed success rate on each evaluated task, including Perturbed Test-Tube Insertion, where it achieves 16/30 successes versus 13/30 for tactile RGB baselines and 1/30 for vision-only. These results demonstrate the potential of mechanochromic structural color as a compact, load-sensitive tactile representation for robot learning and closed-loop manipulation. Project page: https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/.
items.abstract_zh: 现代视触觉传感器主要通过对柔顺界面的变形进行成像来感知接触。利用光度立体等技术，它们可以恢复详细的接触几何，通常表示为表面法线或深度。然而，与力相关的信息通常仍需通过校准、几何重建或学习映射间接推断。力致变色光子晶体（PC）材料提供了一种替代的物理编码机制：接触载荷改变其周期性微结构和光谱响应，将局部应力直接转换为空间分辨的结构色场。尽管具有这种潜力，PC 材料很少被探索用作闭环机器人学习的视触觉传感器。我们提出 PCTac，一种开源力致变色 PC 指尖，使用密集色调场作为其触觉观测。载荷表征表明，施加的法向载荷与观察到的色调响应之间存在可重复的关系。我们进一步将该表示直接集成到扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）中，并在三个真实机器人操作任务上进行评估。在 90 次物理试验中，PCTac Hue 取得 68 次成功（75.6%），而 PCTac RGB 为 60 次（66.7%），Wedge RGB 为 57 次（63.3%），仅视觉为 29 次（32.2%）。PCTac Hue 在每个评估任务上也取得了最高的观测成功率，包括扰动试管插入任务，其中它取得 16/30 次成功，而触觉 RGB 基线为 13/30，仅视觉为 1/30。这些结果展示了力致变色结构色作为紧凑、载荷敏感的触觉表示用于机器人学习和闭环操作的潜力。项目页面：https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/。

items.title_en: ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations
items.title_zh: ForeAct：基于世界表征的几何引导动作学习
items.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人操作需要能够同时捕捉场景几何及其在交互过程中演化的表征。现有方法大多将这两个方面分开处理。世界动作模型通过将动作预测与未来视频生成耦合来捕捉此类动态，但其依赖迭代扩散或整流流推理，导致计算成本高，且其表征缺乏显式空间结构。显式建模场景几何通常需要辅助模块，这会增加参数量和计算成本。相反，以几何为中心的策略主要恢复观测到的空间结构，往往缺乏对交互过程中未来几何变化进行预判的显式监督。为解决这些局限，我们提出 ForeAct，将预训练视频世界模型复用为用于低延迟控制的单次表征骨干。ForeAct 在单次前向传播中直接处理当前观测的干净潜变量，无需合成未来帧和迭代去噪，同时保留骨干网络预训练的时空先验。ForeAct 不引入单独的几何骨干，而是使用由下一帧相对深度监督的可学习 token，通过双向自注意力塑造共享视频表征。这一紧凑接口以很小的参数开销，将骨干中已编码的空间知识转化为面向动作生成的未来感知表征。轻量几何读出仅在训练时使用，部署时移除，从而无需深度输入或外部几何骨干即可实现低延迟、几何感知的控制。无需额外大规模预训练，ForeAct 在 LIBERO 上达到 96.6% 的平均成功率，在 SimplerEnv-Bridge 上达到 63.5%，并在 90 次真实世界 rollout 中达到 74.4% 的成功率。

items.title_en: Experimental Evidence of Cellular Sparing under Single-Pulse Picosecond Irradiation at Extreme Dose Rates
items.title_zh: 极端剂量率下单脉冲皮秒辐照细胞保护效应的实验证据
items.abstract_en: Understanding how biological cells respond to radiation delivered on extremely short timescales is central to resolving the fundamental mechanisms underlying radiotherapy and to defining new regimes of radiobiology. Experimentally accessing these earliest stages of physicochemical response is crucial to benchmark current numerical codes, whose predictions are known to vary substantially with under-constrained early-stage parameters. Using a laser-driven electron source, tunable doses up to 8Gy were delivered to normal and cancer human cell lines, in single pulses of picosecond-scale duration at mean dose rates above 10^10 Gy/s. Clonogenic survival assays and 53BP1 foci formation were compared with conventional X-ray irradiation at 2.4Gy/min. Surviving fractions are found to be comparable to conventional irradiation at doses up to 3Gy. At higher doses, however, all cell lines exhibited a consistent increase in surviving fraction, corresponding to an average RBE at 10% survival of 0.84+/-0.05. This sparing effect is associated with a statistically significant reduction in the beta parameter of the linear-quadratic model, indicating reduced cell killing from accumulated sub-lethal damage. Picosecond irradiation also produced a marked reduction in prompt 53BP1 foci, but no significant difference in residual foci at 24h and foci-size distributions. These results provide the first experimental evidence of cellular sparing following single-pulse picosecond-scale irradiation. Direct comparison with recent work at femtosecond timescales suggests the presence of a previously undetected sharp transition in biological response at the femtosecond/picosecond interface, giving critical insight on the possible mechanisms responsible for this differential response.
items.abstract_zh: 理解生物细胞如何响应极短时间尺度上递送的辐射，是解析放疗基本机制和定义放射生物学新领域的关键。实验上访问这些物理化学响应的最早阶段，对于基准测试当前数值代码至关重要，因为这些代码的预测已知会随约束不足的早期阶段参数而显著变化。使用激光驱动电子源，以皮秒级持续时间的单脉冲、高于 10^10 Gy/s 的平均剂量率，向正常和癌症人类细胞系递送最高 8Gy 的可调剂量。将克隆形成存活实验和 53BP1 焦点形成与 2.4Gy/min 的传统 X 射线辐照进行比较。发现直至 3Gy 剂量时，存活分数与传统辐照相当。然而在更高剂量下，所有细胞系均表现出一致的存活分数增加，对应 10% 存活率下的平均 RBE 为 0.84±0.05。这种保护效应与线性二次模型中 beta 参数的统计学显著降低相关，表明累积亚致死损伤导致的细胞杀伤减少。皮秒辐照还显著减少了即刻 53BP1 焦点，但在 24 小时残留焦点和焦点大小分布上无显著差异。这些结果提供了单脉冲皮秒级辐照后细胞保护效应的首个实验证据。与近期飞秒时间尺度工作的直接比较表明，在飞秒/皮秒界面存在此前未检测到的生物响应急剧转变，为可能导致这种差异响应的机制提供了关键见解。

items.title_en: Comments on: "Optimized thermal control of a dual-wavelength-resonant nonlinear cavity"
items.title_zh: 对“双波长谐振非线性腔的优化热控制”的评论
items.abstract_en: This comment addresses the publication [Appl. Opt. 65, 7090 (2026)] which targets an alleged ``optimization'' of a patented invention conceived by the author. The invention had introduced a multi-temperature management scheme for a dual-wavelength-resonant nonlinear cavity that optimized the crystal temperature around the beam waist for phase-matching, while utilizing independently adjustable temperatures in other regions of the same crystal to simultaneously satisfy the double-resonance condition. A foundational form of this invention was initially utilized by co-author H. Vahlbruch without the author's prior knowledge during the construction of the squeezed-light laser for the Virgo gravitational wave detector. In their publication, the three authors now propose a variant that reduces the maximum achievable temperature differential. Here, I demonstrate that this approach does not constitute an optimization but, on the contrary, represents a regression that dismantles the invention. In general, a high-quality implementation of this invention fundamentally depends on maximizing the achievable temperature differential. Only then can the problematic phase differences---introduced by dielectric coatings, Gouy phase shifts, and suboptimal poling lengths at the crystal facets---be effectively compensated for, particularly in short crystals. If desired, smaller temperature differences can always be selected dynamically anyway.
items.abstract_zh: 本评论针对出版物 [Appl. Opt. 65, 7090 (2026)]，该文针对作者构思的一项专利发明声称实现了“优化”。该发明引入了一种用于双波长谐振非线性腔的多温度管理方案，优化光束腰附近晶体温度以实现相位匹配，同时利用同一晶体其他区域可独立调节的温度来同时满足双谐振条件。该发明的一种基础形式曾在作者不知情的情况下，由共同作者 H. Vahlbruch 在为 Virgo 引力波探测器构建压缩光激光器期间使用。在该出版物中，三位作者现在提出一种减少最大可实现温差的变体。在此，我证明该方法不构成优化，相反，它代表着一种拆解该发明的倒退。一般来说，该发明的高质量实现从根本上取决于最大化可实现的温差。只有这样才能有效补偿由介质膜、Gouy 相移以及晶体端面处非最优极化长度引入的问题相位差，尤其在短晶体中。如有需要，反正始终可以动态选择较小的温差。

items.title_en: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
items.title_zh: 锚定行为而非参数：使用单一共享提示的无回放持续学习
items.abstract_en: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git
items.abstract_zh: 基于提示的持续学习通过调优少量提示 token 来适配冻结的预训练视觉 Transformer。最近，在所有任务间共享单一提示的单提示方法使这一范式实现最大参数效率。悬而未决的问题是，共享提示如何在为新类别更新时保留旧类别知识。现有方法在参数空间中保护旧知识，即冻结任务特定提示、扩展新组件或稀疏门控哪些 token 接收梯度。然而，这种方法牺牲了可塑性，而共享 token 中仍允许的漂移可能破坏提示在过往类别上的功能。必须保留的是提示的行为。我们提出 TEA-Prompt，它耦合了：(i) 一个 token 评估模块，为每个提示 token 分配连续、以输入为条件的相关性分数并注入注意力 logits，在不丢弃任何 token 的情况下跨任务软特化 token；(ii) 一个注意力行为锚定损失，仅使用紧凑高斯查询统计量、无需存储旧图像，并以 token 过去的相关性加权，将每个 token 的注意力输出约束在类别特定查询区域周围。锚定注意力值允许参数继续自由更新，只要其交互保持不变。TEA-Prompt 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R 和 CUB-200 上以仅 0.38M 参数实现最先进准确率，并显著降低遗忘。代码公开于 https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git

items.title_en: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
items.title_zh: EmoHarness：通过元框架演化提升多模态情感理解
items.abstract_en: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 当词语、声音和视觉线索冲突时，小型多模态模型可能误判情绪。我们提出 EmoHarness，将此类模型（冻结的学生模型）置于一个框架（harness）中运行：该框架包含其调用周围的提示、设置和验证代码。一个人工编写的起始框架（脚手架）将学生的视觉观察、转录文本和韵律描述编号为可引用证据，并让学生据此权衡候选情绪。在 Meta-Harness Evolving（MHE）中，更强的 LLM（Builder）离线阅读学生的错误和执行轨迹并编辑框架；静态检查和验证门决定保留哪些编辑，且 Builder 从不接触评估项目。在 5,507 个 MME-Emotion 项目上，EmoHarness 对全部四个学生和两个 Builder，将任务宏平均 Recognition 相比单次仅视频调用提高 7.6–13.4 个百分点。转录文本和韵律描述贡献了大部分提升（+5.38 至 +10.71）；脚手架使音频增强调用变化 -0.79 至 +2.54，部分通过额外的多标签预测实现，演化编辑最多增加 +0.95，尽管没有任何演化增量通过 Holm 校正。框架的情感上下文也可迁移到 IntentQA，四个学生中有三个获得小幅增益，但均未通过校正。因此，EmoHarness 主要通提供和组织音频衍生证据来提升小型多模态学生模型。

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：面向动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM），用于包含动态对象的环境中的稠密建图。在视觉 SLAM（同时定位与建图）中，动态观测可能污染相机跟踪和场景重建。尽管 3DGS（3D 高斯泼溅）能够实现高效稠密建图，但现有 3DGS-SLAM 系统在动态对象违反其底层静态场景假设时可能表现出不稳定性。排除动态观测可以减少其对跟踪和建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束较弱。我们提出的 DPGS-SLAM 是一个单目 RGB SLAM 框架，通过基于扩散的异步背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表征。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和 SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，微调扩散修复模型在遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，同时 Metric3D v2 从补全图像预测度量深度以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元与观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变为可见时，符合条件的生成基元被移除，观测支持的基元由真实 RGB 观测和预测深度独立初始化。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在 TUM RGB-D 上平均 ATE RMSE 为 1.2 cm，在 BONN RGB-D 上为 2.7 cm。在 StaDy4D 上，DPGS-SLAM 仅使用单目 RGB 输入，相比 WildGS-SLAM 将平均 PSNR 提高 4.60 dB。

items.title_en: Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality
items.title_zh: 面向缺失SLO模态BCVA预测的条件扩散代理表征恢复
items.abstract_en: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 术前预测白内障术后最佳矫正视力（BCVA）有助于预后评估与个体化决策。多模态学习可融合术前 OCT 图像、SLO 图像与临床文本以刻画患者状态，但真实临床数据中 SLO 图像常因采集或数据管理问题而缺失，导致多模态输入不完整。为此，本文提出一种基于条件扩散的 SLO 代理表征恢复与融合预测方法。该方法不在像素层面重建原始 SLO 图像，而是把 SLO 缺失问题建模为潜在特征空间中的代理表征恢复：先融合 OCT 图像特征与临床文本特征，构建 OCT-文本条件表征，引导扩散模型的反向去噪过程估计样本特异的 SLO 代理表征；再以该代理表征替代缺失模态，输入下游多模态融合预测网络完成术后 BCVA 预测。实验基于 2,141 例术前多模态白内障样本，SLO 缺失率为 58.80%。在绝对预测误差不超过 0.1 LogMAR 的准则下，方法准确率达 0.9714，平均绝对误差 0.0423，优于代表性术后视力预测与缺失模态学习方法。
items.highlight_zh: 在特征空间而非像素空间补全缺失SLO，提升BCVA预测
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：白内障手术前，医生希望预测病人术后视力（BCVA），以便评估预后、制定个体化方案。做法是把术前 OCT 图像、SLO 图像和临床文本一起输入多模态模型。但真实数据里 SLO 图像经常缺失——本研究的 2,141 例样本中缺失率高达 58.80%，直接导致模型输入不完整、性能下降。

方法：作者没有选择“把缺失的 SLO 图像画出来”这条难走的路，而是把问题搬到特征空间：既然下游模型真正需要的是 SLO 的特征表示，那就只恢复这个表示。具体地，先融合已有的 OCT 图像特征与临床文本特征，得到一个“OCT-文本条件表征”，用它作为条件去引导条件扩散模型的反向去噪过程，从而估计出每个样本专属的 SLO 代理表征。这个代理表征随后顶替缺失的 SLO 模态，进入多模态融合预测网络，输出术后 BCVA 预测值。

结果：在上述 2,141 例数据上，以预测绝对误差在 0.1 LogMAR 以内为准确判据，该方法准确率为 0.9714，平均绝对误差 0.0423，优于若干代表性的术后视力预测方法和缺失模态学习方法。

为何重要：这说明了“表征层面的代理恢复”是应对模态缺失的一条实用思路——不去追求像素级逼真重建，而是直接补齐下游任务真正需要的信息，从而减轻数据缺失对临床预测的影响。对临床多模态数据的鲁棒建模具有借鉴意义。

items.title_en: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.abstract_en: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.
items.abstract_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及跨更广泛组织尺度的相互作用共同调控发育与再生过程中的分子状态转变与形态发生。时间分辨空间转录组学可同时刻画基因表达与空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样的是不同细胞，因而中间轨迹与多尺度细胞间相互作用无法被观测。在我们已有的相互作用平均场神经随机微分方程框架基础上，我们提出stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），这是一个连续时间生成式框架，可从未配对的时空快照中推断耦合的分子、空间与增殖动力学。stMIND将细胞表达速度矢量/漂移分解为三个可解释算子：细胞内在程序；局部图差分注意力算子，在共同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异与空间几何信息；以及非局部平均场注意力算子，捕捉直接邻域之外的长程群体背景。通过使动态空间邻域随细胞迁移一同演化，并强制内在漂移与相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND在表达-位置联合空间中通过最优传输解析尺度特异的细胞间影响。在美西螈与斑马鱼基准测试中，stMIND在表达预测、解剖一致性与空间连贯性方面领先。消融实验证实有必要将互不相交的局部算子与非局部算子结合使用。它揭示了损伤后10至15天美西螈端脑中的再生转变：漂移能量骤增，随后出现非局部主导与局部反平衡，且在反应性室管膜胶质微环境中因细胞类型而异。它追踪了斑马鱼各阶段的发育向量场。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer
items.title_zh: 变分量子电路的权重空间编程：大语言模型无需优化器即可写出量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) optimize circuit angles through repeated quantum-device evaluations, often facing vanishing gradients and high optimization costs. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can write these angles directly. Extending *weight-space programming* from classical networks to quantum circuits, we provide a frontier LLM (\gpt) with the problem, circuit, and gate conventions. Its angles are executed exactly as written, without returning losses, gradients, or accuracy feedback. Across 139 requests, we test handwritten-digit classification, VQE ground-state estimation for spin chains and H$_2$, and MaxCut QAOA, comparing against random weights, classical optimization, and optimization initialized with LLM weights on the same circuit. When parameters have interpretable structure, the LLM matches or approaches the optimizer: it achieves 95--100\% of the energy spectrum on every VQE problem, derives the exact H$_2$ ground state in closed form, finds optimal depth-one QAOA angles for every graph, and reaches 93--96\% accuracy on digits 3 versus 8 with 12--18 hand-written weights, outperforming an optimizer trained on the same ten examples. Its weights are also strong warm starts: optimization reaches its best value after a median of one evaluation rather than hundreds. Allowed to design circuits, the LLM chooses data-dependent rotation chains encoding pixel importance in all 30 cases (one qubit for binary tasks, one chain per qubit for ten classes), reaching 65\% accuracy across ten digits. Yet the approach fails in opaque weight spaces: accuracy drops to chance when fixed circuits exceed 30 weights, while optimization improves. It is also sensitive to gate conventions: 6 of 42 QAOA replies reverse mixing-angle signs and fail. We release all prompts, replies, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）通过反复的量子器件评估来优化电路角度，常面临梯度消失与高昂的优化成本。我们探究大语言模型（LLM）能否直接写出这些角度。我们将*权重空间编程*从经典网络扩展到量子电路，向一个前沿LLM（\gpt）提供问题、电路与门约定。其给出的角度按原样执行，不返回损失、梯度或准确率反馈。在139次请求中，我们测试了手写数字分类、自旋链与H$_2$的VQE基态估计以及MaxCut QAOA，并与随机权重、经典优化以及在同一电路上以LLM权重初始化的优化进行比较。当参数具有可解释结构时，LLM可匹配或接近优化器：它在每个VQE问题上达到能谱的95--100\%，以闭式形式推导出精确的H$_2$基态，为每个图找到最优的一层深度QAOA角度，并在12--18个手写权重下于数字3与8的区分上达到93--96\%的准确率，优于在同样十个示例上训练的优化器。其权重也是强有力的热启动：优化在中位数为一次评估后即达到最优值，而非数百次。在允许设计电路时，LLM在全部30个案例中都选择了编码像素重要性的数据依赖旋转链（二分类任务用一个量子比特，十分类任务每个量子比特一条链），在十个数字上达到65\%的准确率。然而，该方法在不透明权重空间中失效：当固定电路的权重超过30个时，准确率降至随机水平，而优化方法则有所提升。它还对门约定敏感：42个QAOA回复中有6个将混合角符号写反并导致失败。我们公开所有提示、回复与评分。

items.title_en: K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels
items.title_zh: K-prop：通过反向传播时间核的深度在线学习
items.abstract_en: Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.
items.abstract_zh: 自递归是人工与生物神经网络中时间处理的重要组成部分，在生物系统中以漏积分形式自然出现。然而，由于梯度具有复杂的时间依赖性，仍然缺乏高效且有效的在线训练方法。在此我们提出K-prop，一种面向漏神经网络的新型在线学习方法。它通过传播核增益大幅降低实时递归学习（RTRL）的计算与内存开销。K-prop还优于现有的RTRL近似方法，并在序列学习、分类与强化学习任务中取得与时间反向传播相当的性能。我们进一步分析其唯一近似如何影响梯度质量，并确定了K-prop保持准确有效的条件。

items.title_en: CaseLaw: A Policy-Decoupled Framework for Training-Free Content Moderation
items.title_zh: CaseLaw：一种策略解耦的免训练内容审核框架
items.abstract_en: Content moderation is inherently policy-dependent: moderation boundaries are often subtle, subjective, and frequently updated, while conventional rule based or fine-tuning based systems require costly rule rewriting, model retraining, or system redeployment. We propose CaseLaw, a policy-decoupled and training-free framework for adaptive content moderation. CaseLaw reformulates moderation as precedent-based retrieval and voting, where multimodal content is transformed into evidence-preserved structured semantics, embedded into a stable semantic space, and classified by thresholded voting over retrieved precedent labels. We train NoteCap on a large-scale corpus of structurally annotated notes to ensure consistent semantic extraction and freeze it during subsequent policy adaptation, which requires no additional training. Policy adaptation is achieved by updating the semantic case library, including case labels and mappings, without retraining models or modifying prompts. To evaluate CaseLaw, we construct MFO-RedNotes, a benchmark for the male-female opposition risk domain. We additionally provide a five category CoPro comparison. Experiments show that CaseLaw consistently outperforms competing baselines in both precision and recall across policy-dependent risk levels and broader safety categories, with category-wise precision/recall reaching up to 86.8%/90.1% on MFO-RedNotes across both policy settings and 94.5%/92.3% on CoPro. Our work highlights the potential of precedent-based reasoning for policy adaptive content moderation and offers a practical direction toward more stable, transparent, and training-free moderation systems.
items.abstract_zh: 内容审核本质上依赖策略：审核边界往往细微、主观且频繁更新，而传统的基于规则或基于微调的系统需要进行代价高昂的规则重写、模型再训练或系统重新部署。我们提出CaseLaw，一个策略解耦且免训练的自适应内容审核框架。CaseLaw将审核重新表述为基于先例的检索与投票：多模态内容被转换为保留证据的结构化语义，嵌入稳定的语义空间，并通过对检索到的先例标签进行阈值投票来分类。我们在大规模结构化标注笔记语料上训练NoteCap，以确保一致的语义提取，并在后续策略适配过程中将其冻结，无需额外训练。策略适配通过更新语义案例库（包括案例标签与映射）实现，无需重新训练模型或修改提示。为评估CaseLaw，我们构建了MFO-RedNotes，一个面向男女对立风险领域的基准。我们还提供了五类别的CoPro对比。实验表明，CaseLaw在依赖策略的风险等级与更广泛的安全类别上，在精确率与召回率两方面均持续优于竞争基线；在两个策略设置下，MFO-RedNotes上的分类别精确率/召回率最高达86.8%/90.1%，CoPro上达94.5%/92.3%。我们的工作凸显了基于先例的推理在策略自适应内容审核中的潜力，并为构建更稳定、透明且免训练的审核系统提供了可行方向。

items.title_en: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
items.title_zh: 超越内存限制：面向大规模三维自主探索的层次化时空地图表示
items.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）探索越来越多地用于难以进入或受灾环境中的大规模测绘与巡检，而这些场景中机载内存与计算资源往往严重受限。现有大多数无人机探索系统为运动规划与探索决策维护可全局查询的几何地图表示，导致内存消耗与空间查询成本随已探索区域增大而增加。以机器人为中心的局部建图可限制稠密地图的内存与计算，但会丢弃长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出FLAVOR，一个层次化时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图内，同时保留紧凑的全局观测与任务上下文。在观测层，轻量级LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留用于前沿推理的逐射线证据。在任务层，超出局部地图范围的未解决前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待处理任务。稀疏拓扑图通过保留的路线连接这些锚点，以供未来重访。当返回某任务区域时，FLAVOR从观测中重建前沿与探索视点，拓扑路线在执行前被实例化并针对当前局部地图进行验证。随着探索扩展，稠密地图容量保持固定，依赖探索的内存增长仅局限于紧凑的观测与任务上下文。FLAVOR相比完成全部三个仿真场景的最佳基线，探索时间缩短31.98--41.88%，地图内存占用减小94--99%。在真实部署中，相对于显式点云ikd-tree，其在森林场景将内存占用降低92.67%，在建筑工地降低62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。

items.title_en: TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors
items.title_zh: TransArt3D：从两个状态到基于视频过渡先验的铰接式三维重建
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.
items.abstract_zh: 从少量图像重建可交互的铰接式资产是机器人与仿真领域的关键任务，但该问题高度欠约束。现有的基于优化的方法在静态三维先验下拟合铰接式资产，而该先验独立地对每个状态评分，因此每个状态的重建误差会泄漏到估计的运动部件和关节中，形成虚假运动。视频扩散模型能够捕捉物体在状态之间的运动方式，但仅在二维中隐式表达。为此，我们提出TransArt3D，一种基于优化的框架，通过将这种视频过渡先验转化为显式的部件结构和关节运动学，从两张端点图像重建铰接式三维资产。它首先使用过渡耦合的三维一致性，将端点之间生成的帧进行提升，该一致性在帧间联合应用静态三维先验，从而稳定不变区域并初始化部件和关节。随后，整流流运动学细化让视频先验监督整个过渡过程中的三维运动场，同时部件分配和共享关节在整个优化过程中约束该运动场，使每个状态的误差不进入铰接结构。最后，运动感知的规范外观融合利用恢复出的铰接结构将两张端点图像映射到一个规范表面上，为仅由一个状态揭示的区域进行纹理化。在PartNet-Mobility上，TransArt3D在几何和关节精度上优于给定相同两张端点图像的方法，并在铰接状态几何、关节定位和外观方面超过给定六个观测状态的方法。

items.title_en: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞RNA测序数据细胞类型分类的突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）
items.abstract_en: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，原因包括高维性、稀疏性以及转录上相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，它是对树突神经元模型的改编，融合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。基于Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优均独立于外层测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个任务中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其后是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持树突和突触阈值的贡献。然而，XGBoost取得了更高的平均二分类任务准确率（96.20%对scDNM的95.32%），且跨任务排名差异在统计上不显著。这些发现表明，scDNM在scRNA-seq细胞类型分类中具有竞争力，但仍需要更广泛的独立验证。

items.title_en: High-sensitivity sensing technology of 10 MHz radio frequency electric field based on Rydberg atoms
items.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子的10 MHz射频电场高灵敏度传感技术
items.abstract_en: To address the pressing need for high-sensitivity, miniaturized electric field sensors in the short-wave communication band (3-30 MHz), this study proposes and demonstrates a radio frequency electric field quantum sensing scheme based on cesium atomic Rydberg states and the electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) effect. The scheme employs an all-infrared optical design, utilizing 852 nm probe light, 1470 nm dressing light, and 780 nm coupling light to efficiently prepare the 49P3/2 Rydberg state in a room-temperature cesium vapor cell, which is then probed non-destructively via ladder-type four-level EIT spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 为满足短波通信频段（3-30 MHz）对高灵敏度、小型化电场传感器的迫切需求，本研究提出并演示了一种基于铯原子里德堡态和电磁诱导透明（EIT）效应的射频电场量子传感方案。该方案采用全红外光学设计，利用852 nm探测光、1470 nm缀饰光和780 nm耦合光，在室温铯蒸气池中高效制备49P3/2里德堡态，随后通过阶梯型四能级EIT光谱对其进行非破坏性探测。

items.title_en: HyInv Technical Report
items.title_zh: HyInv技术报告
items.abstract_en: Inverse folding designs amino-acid sequences for a given protein backbone, and screening needs many candidates that are both diverse and well folded. We present HyInv, a 1.96-million-parameter backbone-conditioned graph network with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team: pretrained with random-order autoregressive sequence modeling, followed by structure-reward reinforcement learning. At inference, a grouped draft-and-rewrite sampler that uses separate draft and rewrite temperatures improves refolding TM-score at matched diversity. An optimized implementation with BF16 numerics designs 128 sequences for a 402-residue backbone in 50.6 ms on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, about 52 times faster than the reference sampler, and an exact FP32 path that returns the reference sequences is 8.7 times faster. Across five benchmark datasets and seven dataset-predictor combinations, HyInv reaches a higher average scTM than all ten external baselines at comparable or higher sequence diversity, with large margins over ProteinMPNN and ProteinZero V2. The same default setting supports de novo backbones, pocket-constrained libraries, enzyme redesign with the catalytic site kept, and loop redesign. We have released our code and model at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv.
items.abstract_zh: 逆折叠为给定蛋白质主链设计氨基酸序列，而筛选需要大量既多样又折叠良好的候选序列。我们提出HyInv，一种具有编码器-解码器架构、参数量为196万的以主链为条件的图网络，由我们团队开发的研究智能体Hyra 2.0训练：先以随机顺序自回归序列建模进行预训练，再进行结构奖励强化学习。在推理时，一种使用分别的起草温度和重写温度的分组起草-重写采样器在匹配多样性下提高了重折叠TM-score。采用BF16数值的优化实现在单块NVIDIA H20 GPU上为402个残基的主链设计128条序列耗时50.6 ms，比参考采样器快约52倍；而返回参考序列的精确FP32路径快8.7倍。在五个基准数据集和七种数据集-预测器组合上，HyInv在相当或更高的序列多样性下，其平均scTM高于全部十个外部基线，并对ProteinMPNN和ProteinZero V2具有较大优势。相同的默认设置支持从头主链、口袋约束文库、保留催化位点的酶重新设计以及环区重新设计。我们已在https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv发布代码和模型。

items.title_en: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
items.title_zh: ScrapeBench：评估AI智能体在网站抓取中的法律合规性
items.abstract_en: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and robots.txt directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and robots.txt, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.
items.abstract_zh: 部署在开放网络上的AI智能体越来越有能力执行可能违反合同条款和违反计算机安全法的操作。在本文中，我们提出ScrapeBench，这是首个用于实证评估AI智能体对网站抓取政策（即服务条款（ToS）和robots.txt指令）法律合规性的智能体基准。在广泛使用的闭权重和开放权重AI智能体中，我们发现，在我们选取的1,626个明确禁止抓取的流行网站样本中，当被指示抓取网站时，大多数智能体表现出较低的合规率（< 5%）。此外，我们观察到，即使AI智能体主动检查适用的ToS和robots.txt，它们仍表现出较低的合规率。相反，在我们选取的269个不禁止抓取的网站样本中，我们观察到智能体有时尽管抓取合法却拒绝抓取，例如Claude Opus 4.6表现出98.5%的过度拒绝率。我们的人类基线实验（n = 180名参与者）表明，人类的合规率与AI智能体相当，但过度拒绝率要高得多。

items.title_en: Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agentic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 通过盲区推理与视觉语言模型智能体对话的选择性协同感知
items.abstract_en: Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. Efficiency can be significantly improved by selectively performing CP only in safety-critical scenarios and for key occluding objects. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are well-suited for complex reasoning in dynamic and uncertain environments, making them a promising tool for this selective CP task. This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based CP. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. The framework also incorporates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting mechanism to enhance interpretability and intent-aware decision-making. We collect real-world data from connected vehicles operating in urban traffic and compare the driving-critical blind spot identification and dialogue performance of four state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves over 80% accuracy in driving-critical blind spot detection and over 90% success in dialogue-driven perception sharing. This work provides a scalable, interpretable, and bandwidth-efficient alternative to conventional CP pipelines, and offers new insights into agentic communication design for future connected traffic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体交通环境中的实时协同感知（CP）高度资源密集，这给大规模部署带来了可扩展性挑战。通过仅在安全关键场景以及针对关键遮挡对象选择性地执行CP，可以显著提高效率。视觉语言模型（VLM）非常适合在动态和不确定环境中进行复杂推理，使其成为这一选择性CP任务的有前景工具。本研究提出了一种由VLM驱动的智能体框架，用于盲区推理和基于对话的CP。设计了一种混合模型架构，集成了用于稳定感知的传统目标检测、用于识别有影响遮挡的视觉语言推理，以及一个基于物理的几何模块，以使推理与现实世界可见性约束对齐。该框架还引入了思维链（CoT）提示机制，以增强可解释性和意图感知决策。我们收集了在城市交通中运行的网联车辆的真实世界数据，并比较了四种最先进VLM在驾驶关键盲区识别和对话方面的性能。实验结果表明，我们的方法在驾驶关键盲区检测中达到超过80%的准确率，在对话驱动的感知共享中达到超过90%的成功率。这项工作为传统CP流水线提供了一种可扩展、可解释且带宽高效的替代方案，并为未来网联交通系统的智能体通信设计提供了新见解。

items.title_en: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
items.title_zh: 训练视觉Transformer以聚焦：空间注意力头专门化的涌现
items.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.
items.abstract_zh: 在Vision Transformer模型（如DINO）中，自监督学习通过利用大规模图像数据集，能够在无需标注数据的情况下实现稳健的视觉感知。然而，这些模型在训练过程中缺乏聚焦机制，导致感知表征往往模糊或过于相似。在本工作中，我们引入两种视觉聚焦损失函数，旨在建立模型注意力与图像内特定区域之间的对应关系。具体而言，我们利用模型内的多头注意力机制来选择性地引导模型聚焦，从而促成空间注意力头专门化的涌现，其特征是在无需注释的情况下具备多样且空间聚焦的感知能力。通过定性和定量评估，我们证明我们的方法大幅提高了注意力头的空间选择性和多样性，同时提升了可解释性以及在零样本图像分割等稠密预测任务上的性能。

items.title_en: Protein B-factor modeling with local magnitude
items.title_zh: 基于局部magnitude的蛋白质B因子建模
items.abstract_en: Topological magnitude characterizes the effective size and spatial organization of metric spaces, offering a geometric approach with potential applications in molecular biology and materials science. Previous work has demonstrated its utility in modeling protein flexibility from structure, but global magnitude weighting requires dense linear systems whose computational cost increases with protein size. We introduce a local magnitude representation that retains residue-level structural information through nearest-neighbor environments. The construction is well posed and geometrically invariant, with central weighting distinguished from scalar neighborhood magnitude. Across 364 proteins, the mean within-protein fitting Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) increases from 0.725 for global magnitude to 0.728 for local magnitude. Blind-prediction experiments on 345 proteins combine each representation with identical auxiliary descriptors and evaluate random forests and gradient boosting under three validation protocols. Local features improve the primary PCC in all six model--protocol comparisons, with a maximum absolute increase of 0.008 in protein-level ten-fold gradient boosting. For a fixed feature bank, local factorization costs $O(Nk^3)$ compared with $O(N^3)$ for global factorization, where $N$ is the number of C$_α$ atoms and $k$ the neighborhood size. Timing measurements show a computational advantage of local magnitude on large structures. Within the tested single-seed configuration and distinct global and local scale banks, these results support local magnitude as a compact representation that preserves useful B-factor information while reducing feature-extraction costs for large proteins.
items.abstract_zh: 拓扑magnitude刻画度量空间的有效大小和空间组织，提供了一种几何方法，在分子生物学和材料科学中具有潜在应用。先前工作已证明其在从结构建模蛋白质柔性方面的效用，但全局magnitude加权需要稠密线性系统，其计算成本随蛋白质规模增加。我们引入一种局部magnitude表示，通过最近邻环境保留残基级结构信息。该构造是适定的且具有几何不变性，其中中心加权与标量邻域magnitude相区分。在364个蛋白质上，蛋白质内平均拟合Pearson相关系数（PCC）从全局magnitude的0.725提高到局部magnitude的0.728。在345个蛋白质上的盲预测实验将每种表示与相同的辅助描述符结合，并在三种验证协议下评估随机森林和梯度提升。在全部六项模型—协议比较中，局部特征均提高了主要PCC，在蛋白质级十折梯度提升中最大绝对提升为0.008。对于固定特征库，局部分解的成本为$O(Nk^3)$，而全局分解为$O(N^3)$，其中$N$是C$_α$原子数，$k$是邻域大小。计时测量显示，局部magnitude在大结构上具有计算优势。在测试的单随机种子配置以及不同的全局和局部尺度库下，这些结果支持局部magnitude作为一种紧凑表示，在保留有用B因子信息的同时降低大蛋白质的特征提取成本。

items.title_en: On the estimation of linear-optical amplitudes and probabilities with entangled input state
items.title_zh: 论使用纠缠输入态估计线性光学振幅与概率
items.abstract_en: Most proposed applications of boson samplers, including photonic machine-learning models, do not use the samples themselves but estimates of output probabilities, marginals or overlaps, obtained to additive precision from a finite number of shots. For product inputs such as single photons, these quantities can already be estimated classically with Gurvits's algorithm and its generalisations. We ask whether entangled inputs change this picture. For any $n$-photon input that is a matrix-product state of bond dimension $χ$, with one photon per site and $L$ modes per site, we give an unbiased estimator of any output amplitude of an $m$-mode interferometer, whose mean-square error after $N$ draws is at most $\|ψ\|^2/N$ whatever the interferometer, the output pattern and the entanglement of the state. Each draw costs $O(nLχ^2+nL^3+mn)$ operations after $O(nLχ^3)$ preprocessing, and an additive error $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$ requires $O(\|ψ\|^2\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$ draws, with memory of the order of the input size. The main application is to light emitted sequentially by quantum emitters, such as spin-based sources of photonic cluster states, for which $χ$ is bounded by the dimension of the source's retained quantum memory: one spin gives $χ=2$ at any length, and a memory of $k$ qubits, held in emitters or in photons stored in a delay line, gives $χ\le2^k$, so the cost stays polynomial as long as $k=O(\log n)$. The same sampler also estimates traced-memory probabilities, overlaps and individual marginal probabilities. All guarantees are additive: the estimator gives neither relative estimates of exponentially small probabilities nor a sampler of the output distribution.
items.abstract_zh: 大多数玻色采样器的拟议应用，包括光子机器学习模型，并不使用样本本身，而是使用输出概率、边缘概率或重叠的估计值；这些估计值以加性精度从有限次采样中获得。对于单光子等乘积输入，这些量已经可以用Gurvits算法及其推广进行经典估计。我们追问纠缠输入是否会改变这一图景。对于任何$n$光子输入，若其为键维数为$χ$的矩阵乘积态，每个格点一个光子且每个格点$L$个模式，我们给出$m$模式干涉仪任意输出振幅的无偏估计量；无论干涉仪、输出图案和态的纠缠如何，经过$N$次抽取后的均方误差至多为$\|ψ\|^2/N$。每次抽取在$O(nLχ^3)$预处理后需要$O(nLχ^2+nL^3+mn)$次运算；以至少$1-δ$的概率达到加性误差$\varepsilon$需要$O(\|ψ\|^2\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$次抽取，内存量级为输入规模。主要应用是由量子发射器顺序发射的光，例如基于自旋的光子簇态源；对此，$χ$受源所保留量子记忆的维度限制：一个自旋在任何长度下都给出$χ=2$，而由发射器或存储在延迟线中的光子所保持的$k$量子比特记忆给出$χ\le2^k$，因此只要$k=O(\log n)$，成本保持多项式。同一采样器还估计迹记忆概率、重叠以及单个边缘概率。所有保证都是加性的：该估计器既不给出指数小概率的相对估计，也不是输出分布的采样器。

items.title_en: An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models
items.title_zh: 将表格基础模型作为免训练世界模型的评估
items.abstract_en: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型被广泛视为基于模型的强化学习和机器人规划的一个潜在关键组成部分，但通常需要在大量交互数据上进行任务特定训练。我们研究一个预训练的表格基础模型（TabFM）能否通过将下一状态预测表述为对转移对的上下文回归，作为免训练的动力学模型用于世界建模，并考察这种模型在何处有帮助、在何处失效。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准上，几乎所有设置中，TabFM都比在相同有限转移上从头训练的LSTM和MLP模型更准确；在拟合相同数据的回归器中，它在运动任务上最准确，而高斯过程在平滑低维系统上更准确。然而，在大多数系统上，在完整数据集上训练的模型仍然明显更好。当自回归多步展开时，TabFM的准确性强烈依赖于给定上下文的多少。在短上下文下，其展开很快退化到平凡基线的水平；而在长上下文下，它们显著改善，并在一个运动任务上超过训练过的LSTM。推理速度也比LSTM慢约三个数量级。总体而言，在当前状态下，我们发现免训练先验在数据稀缺且有足够上下文时作为预测器是有用的，但它们尚不能替代规划中经过训练的世界模型。

items.title_en: Evaluating Physically Grounded Procedural Reasoning in VLMs through Real-World Execution: Crochet as a Testbed
items.title_zh: 通过真实世界执行评估VLM中物理落地的程序性推理：以钩针编织作为测试平台
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate procedures that look convincing on paper, but do they work in practice? In this paper, we propose crochet as an ideal testbed for physically grounded procedural reasoning in VLMs. Crochet cannot be reliably simulated or automated: the only way to know what a pattern produces is to make it by hand, yet verification is tangible and cheap, requiring nothing but a hook and a ball of yarn. We introduce FoundationChain, a deceptively simple test of procedural reasoning: given an image of a basic crochet object, can VLMs infer how it was made and generate a pattern that produces the same result? We crochet 40 patterns generated by four VLMs by hand. Even at this scale, physical execution not only reveals failures that automated proxies cannot detect, but also enables a more precise diagnosis of their causes and consequences: while models write fluent, convincing patterns, only four are free of errors, and our analysis exposes deficiencies in visual, geometric and procedural reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可以生成在纸面上看起来令人信服的流程，但它们在实践中有效吗？在本文中，我们提出钩针编织作为VLM中物理落地程序性推理的理想测试平台。钩针编织无法被可靠地仿真或自动化：要知道一个图解会产生什么，唯一的方法就是手工制作；然而验证是具体且廉价的，只需要一个钩针和一团毛线。我们引入FoundationChain，一个看似简单的程序性推理测试：给定一个基础钩针编织物品的图像，VLM能否推断它是如何制作的，并生成产生相同结果的图解？我们手工钩织了四个VLM生成的40个图解。即使在这一规模下，物理执行不仅揭示了自动化代理无法检测的失败，还使得对其原因和后果进行更精确的诊断成为可能：尽管模型写出流畅、令人信服的图解，只有四个没有错误，我们的分析暴露了视觉、几何和程序性推理方面的缺陷。

items.title_en: OfficeTwin: Realizing 3D Reconstruction of Redundant Scenes through Partial Viewpoint Perception
items.title_zh: OfficeTwin：通过部分视角感知实现冗余场景的三维重建
items.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction turns an uncalibrated monocular stream into a dense point cloud in a single inference pass, orders of magnitude faster than classical structure-from-motion (e.g., COLMAP), and reliable on the weakly textured, repetitive surfaces where keypoint matching fails outright. However, raw point clouds lack the object identity, physical properties, and watertight volume required for robot learning. This gap widens under robot-native capture. A camera mounted on a robot constrained to a few degrees of freedom sees each object only partially, and the repetitive, weakly textured structure of an office makes distinct workstations nearly indistinguishable, leaving redundant and partial observations that downstream reconstruction cannot resolve. Existing image-to-3D generation methods struggle with these conditions, hallucinating geometry under incomplete views and confusing repeated instances. We present OfficeTwin, a robot-native framework that converts these incomplete observations into simulation-ready digital twins. OfficeTwin first imposes metric and structural constraints, then exploits the office's structural redundancy by registering repeated cubicles into a shared canonical frame, where complementary observations recover geometry occluded in any single view without hallucination. On a real office scan, OfficeTwin recovers every cubicle as an individually watertight, metric solid, outperforming feed-forward reconstruction and generative baselines that fail to produce simulation-ready assets.
items.abstract_zh: 前馈三维重建在单次推理过程中将未标定的单目视频流转换为稠密点云，比经典运动恢复结构（如COLMAP）快几个数量级，并且在关键点匹配完全失败的弱纹理、重复表面上可靠。然而，原始点云缺乏机器人学习所需的物体身份、物理属性以及水密体积。这一差距在机器人原生采集下进一步扩大。安装在仅具有少数自由度的机器人上的相机只能部分看到每个物体，而办公室重复、弱纹理的结构使不同工作站几乎无法区分，留下下游重建无法解决的冗余和部分观测。现有图像到三维生成方法在这些条件下表现不佳，在不完整视图下幻觉出几何结构，并混淆重复实例。我们提出OfficeTwin，一个机器人原生框架，将这些不完整观测转换为可用于仿真的数字孪生。OfficeTwin首先施加度量和结构约束，然后通过将重复的隔间配准到共享规范帧来利用办公室的结构冗余；在该规范帧中，互补观测能够恢复任一单视图中被遮挡的几何结构而无需幻觉。在真实办公室扫描中，OfficeTwin将每个隔间恢复为单独水密、具有度量尺度的实体，优于前馈重建和无法生成仿真就绪资产的生成式基线。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.
