items.title_en: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
items.title_zh: 二阶线性响应能在多大程度上预测量化失配？在五个语言模型上的预注册测量
items.abstract_en: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.
items.abstract_zh: 服务系统为每个模型和部署选择权重格式。一种低成本筛选使用 $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$ 从无量化模型的Fisher信息预测由此产生的KL散度，该展开是Hessian感知和二阶训练后量化器的基础。我们在GPU批处理中，在Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B、OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-32B和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，使用逐通道int8、逐张量fp8和分组int4评估该筛选的可靠性。相对预测在16倍的扰动尺度范围、int4组大小和舍入模式下保持成立，而绝对预测呈重尾分布。修剪平均使Qwen3-4B和OLMo-2上的12个单元格中的10个处于实测KL的15%以内。MoE模型在小扰动下表现出非二次响应，int8 KL按 $α^{0.63}$ 缩放。在bf16中计算逐序列梯度可能导致四倍的预测误差。我们将这些误差追溯到反向传播下半部分的算术，并通过在那里使用fp32消除它们。批不变内核以0.55倍的吞吐量运行，而归约顺序的变化引入每个序列0.17–0.22 nats的下限。我们构建一个筛选器，包含一次流式fp32 Fisher遍历、带区间的修剪张量块预测、对齐张量的标志以及逐层格式分配。在未见过的Mistral-7B-v0.3系列上，所有六个预测都落在区间内，所有三个KL预算均得到满足，vLLM吞吐量的预测误差在0.4%以内。

items.title_en: Deploying Physically and Epistemically Compliant Agents by Distilling Belief-Space Task and Motion Planners
items.title_zh: 通过蒸馏信念空间任务与运动规划器部署物理与认知合规的智能体
items.abstract_en: In this work, we train agents to act under uncertainty according to specified, belief-dependent rules. Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can in theory train agents to follow rules if encoded into well-designed rewards, but in practice, RL fails to perfectly optimize these rewards, leading to ineffective or noncompliant agent behavior. Belief-space planners by construction produce behavior in line with developer specification, but require hand-programming online planners and belief-state estimators, adding significant engineering complexity at scale. We combine the two: we plan offline to generate a dataset of sample trajectories and then distill the plans into a policy that acts on raw observations. We propose two changes to planner distillation that address problems specific to history-based policies: Dual Averaging, a loss that combines per-timestep predictive loss and average loss on task changes, and $ρ$-Optimal Reinforcement, a feedback mechanism that reinforces the policy's own successful rollouts when these are near-optimal. We provide a sufficient condition under which static search problems with noiseless observation models is complete, and show that maximum-likelihood-observation planning implies this condition in static search with continuous beliefs. We create a challenging new domain, Scavenger, where an agent needs to gain information in order to succeed. We evaluate our distilled policy in two versions of Scavenger, one where information is provided visually and one where it is provided as a command in natural language. In either case, the learned policy attains a success rate above 90% in Scavenger, compared with at most 5% for RL. We also find that distilled planners transfer with greater than 60% success to following unseen and intentionally vague commands and greater than 75% success to following floorplans larger than those seen in training.
items.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们训练智能体在不确定性下根据指定的、依赖信念的规则行动。深度强化学习（RL）理论上可以通过将规则编码到精心设计的奖励中来训练智能体遵循规则，但在实践中，RL无法完美优化这些奖励，导致智能体行为无效或不合规。信念空间规划器在构造上产生符合开发者规范的行为，但需要手工编程在线规划器和信念状态估计器，在大规模应用中增加了显著的工程复杂性。我们将两者结合：离线规划以生成样本轨迹数据集，然后将规划蒸馏为作用于原始观测的策略。我们提出对规划器蒸馏的两项改变，以解决基于历史的策略特有的问题：对偶平均（Dual Averaging），一种结合每时间步预测损失和任务变化上的平均损失的损失函数；以及 $ρ$-最优强化（$ρ$-Optimal Reinforcement），一种反馈机制，当策略自身的成功 rollout 接近最优时对其进行强化。我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下具有无噪声观测模型的静态搜索问题是完备的，并证明最大似然观测规划在具有连续信念的静态搜索中蕴含该条件。我们创建一个具有挑战性的新领域Scavenger，其中智能体需要获取信息才能成功。我们在Scavenger的两个版本中评估蒸馏策略，一个版本以视觉方式提供信息，另一个版本以自然语言命令方式提供信息。在任一情况下，学习到的策略在Scavenger中达到90%以上的成功率，而RL至多为5%。我们还发现，蒸馏规划器以超过60%的成功率迁移到遵循未见且故意模糊的命令，并以超过75%的成功率迁移到遵循比训练中所见更大的平面图。
